icy-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Granizo que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
icy-rock.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Hail when used by the holder.
icy-rock.efectoItemEN: Held: The holder’s Hail will create a hailstorm lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

smooth-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Tormenta de Arena que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
smooth-rock.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sandstorm when used by the holder.
smooth-rock.efectoItemEN: Held: The holder’s Sandstorm will create a sandstorm lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

heat-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Día Soleado que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
heat-rock.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sunny Day when used by the holder.
heat-rock.efectoItemEN: Held: The holder’s Sunny Day will create sunshine lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

damp-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Danza Lluvia que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
damp-rock.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Rain Dance when used by the holder.
damp-rock.efectoItemEN: Held: The holder’s Rain Dance will create rain lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

grip-claw.descES: Prolonga la duración de ataques multiturno como Atadura y Constricción si la lleva un Pokémon.
grip-claw.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of multi-turn attacks, such as Bind and Wrap.
grip-claw.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the duration of the holder’s multiturn (2-5 turn) moves by three turns.

choice-scarf.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Potencia la Velocidad, pero solo permite usar un movimiento.
choice-scarf.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts Speed but only allows the use of one move.
choice-scarf.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Speed by 50%, but restricts it to the first move it uses until it leaves battle or loses this item. If this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo, the holder’s restriction is still lifted, but it will again be restricted to the next move it uses. (Quirk: If the holder is switched in by U-Turn and it also knows U-Turn, U-Turn becomes its restricted move.)

sticky-barb.descES: Daña en cada turno al Pokémon que la lleva. Puede adherirse al Pokémon que alcance con su ataque al portador.
sticky-barb.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It damages the holder every turn and may latch on to Pokémon that touch the holder.
sticky-barb.efectoItemEN: Held: Damaged the holder for 1/8 its max HP. When the holder is struck by a contact move, damages the attacker for 1/8 its max HP; if the attacker is not holding an item, it will take this item.

power-bracer.descES: Potencia el Ataque de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
power-bracer.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder’s Attack stat to grow more after battling.
power-bracer.efectoItemEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Attack effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-belt.descES: Potencia la Defensa de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
power-belt.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder’s Defense stat to grow more after battling.
power-belt.efectoItemEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Defense effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-lens.descES: Potencia el Ataque Especial de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-lens.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder’s Sp. Atk stat to grow more after battling.
power-lens.efectoItemEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Special Attack effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-band.descES: Potencia la Defensa Especial de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-band.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder’s Sp. Def stat to grow more after battling.
power-band.efectoItemEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Special Defense effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-anklet.descES: Potencia la Velocidad de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-anklet.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder’s Speed stat to grow more after battling.
power-anklet.efectoItemEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Speed effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-weight.descES: Mejora los PS de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-weight.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder’s max HP to grow more after battling.
power-weight.efectoItemEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains HP effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

shed-shell.descES: En combate, esta concha desechada permite que el portador siempre pueda cambiarse por otro Pokémon que no esté combatiendo.
shed-shell.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This discarded carapace enables the holder to switch out of battle without fail.
shed-shell.efectoItemEN: Held: The holder is unaffected by any moves or abilities that would prevent it from actively leaving battle.

big-root.descES: El Pokémon que la lleva recupera más PS al usar movimientos que drenan al objetivo.
big-root.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the amount of HP the holder restores from HP-stealing moves.
big-root.efectoItemEN: Held: HP restored from Absorb, Aqua Ring, Drain Punch, Dream Eater, Giga Drain, Ingrain, Leech Life, Leech Seed, and Mega Drain is increased by 30%. Damage inflicted is not affected.

choice-specs.descES: Aumentan la potencia de los ataques especiales del Pokémon que las lleva, pero solo le permiten usar un movimiento.
choice-specs.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These curious glasses boost Sp. Atk but only allow the use of one move.
choice-specs.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Special Attack by 50%, but restricts it to the first move it uses until it leaves battle or loses this item. If this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo, the holder’s restriction is still lifted, but it will again be restricted to the next move it uses. (Quirk: If the holder is switched in by U-Turn and it also knows U-Turn, U-Turn becomes its restricted move.)

flame-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
flame-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.
flame-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Fire moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Fire.

splash-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Agua. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
splash-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Water-type moves.
splash-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Water moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Water.

zap-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
zap-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Electric-type moves.
zap-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Electric moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Electric.

meadow-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Planta. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
meadow-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.
meadow-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Grass moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Grass.

icicle-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Hielo. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
icicle-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ice-type moves.
icicle-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ice moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Ice.

fist-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Lucha. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
fist-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fighting-type moves.
fist-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Fighting moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Fighting.

toxic-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Veneno. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
toxic-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.
toxic-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Poison moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Poison.

earth-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Tierra. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
earth-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.
earth-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ground moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Ground.

sky-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Volador. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
sky-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.
sky-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Flying moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Flying.

mind-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Psíquico. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
mind-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.
mind-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Psychic moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Psychic.

insect-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Bicho. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
insect-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.
insect-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Bug moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Bug.

stone-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Roca. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
stone-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.
stone-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Rock moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Rock.

spooky-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fantasma. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
spooky-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.
spooky-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ghost moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Ghost.

draco-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
draco-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dragon-type moves.
draco-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Dragon moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Dragon.

dread-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Siniestro. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
dread-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Dark-type moves.
dread-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Dark moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Dark.

iron-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
iron-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Steel-type moves.
iron-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Steel moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Steel.

odd-incense.descES: Incienso de exótico aroma que fortalece los movimientos de tipo Psíquico. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
odd-incense.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.
odd-incense.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Psychic moves by 20%.

rock-incense.descES: Incienso de exótico aroma que fortalece los movimientos de tipo Roca. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
rock-incense.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense boosts the power of Rock-type moves.
rock-incense.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Rock moves by 20%.

full-incense.descES: Incienso de exótico aroma que hace que el Pokémon que lo lleve esté aturdido y se mueva más despacio.
full-incense.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense makes the holder bloated and slow moving.
full-incense.efectoItemEN: Held: The holder will go last within its move’s priority bracket, regardless of Speed. If multiple Pokémon within the same priority bracket are subject to this effect, the slower Pokémon will go first. The holder will move after Pokémon with Stall. If the holder has Stall, Stall is ignored. This item ignores Trick Room.

wave-incense.descES: Tiene un curioso aroma que potencia los movimientos de tipo Agua. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
wave-incense.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This incense has a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.
wave-incense.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Water moves by 20%.

rose-incense.descES: Incienso de exótico aroma que fortalece los movimientos de tipo Planta. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
rose-incense.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense boosts the power of Grass-type moves.
rose-incense.efectoItemEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Grass moves by 20%.

luck-incense.descES: Si el Pokémon que lo lleva lucha en un combate, duplica las ganancias.
luck-incense.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles any prize money received if the holding Pokémon joins a battle.
luck-incense.efectoItemEN: Held: Doubles the money the trainer receives after an in-game trainer battle. This effect cannot apply more than once to the same battle.

pure-incense.descES: Si lo lleva el primer Pokémon del equipo, se reduce la probabilidad de que se acerquen Pokémon salvajes.
pure-incense.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the head of the party.
pure-incense.efectoItemEN: Held by lead Pokémon: Prevents wild battles with Pokémon that are lower level than the holder.

protector.descES: Dispositivo de protección muy pesado. Cierto Pokémon lo adora.
protector.descEN: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.
protector.efectoItemEN: Held by Rhydon: Evolves the holder into Rhyperior when traded.

electirizer.descES: Este dispositivo contiene una gran cantidad de energía eléctrica. Cierto Pokémon lo adora.
electirizer.descEN: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.
electirizer.efectoItemEN: Held by Electabuzz: Evolves the holder into Electivire when traded.

magmarizer.descES: Esta caja contiene una enorme cantidad de energía magmática. Cierto Pokémon la adora.
magmarizer.descEN: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.
magmarizer.efectoItemEN: Held by Magmar: Evolves the holder into Magmortar when traded.

dubious-disc.descES: Dispositivo transparente que contiene datos misteriosos. Es de fabricante desconocido.
dubious-disc.descEN: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.
dubious-disc.efectoItemEN: Held by Porygon2: Evolves the holder into Porygon-Z when traded.

reaper-cloth.descES: Tela imbuida de una energía espiritual muy potente. Cierto Pokémon la adora.
reaper-cloth.descEN: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.
reaper-cloth.efectoItemEN: Held by Dusclops: Evolves the holder into Dusknoir when traded.

razor-claw.descES: Aumenta la probabilidad de que el Pokémon que la lleve consiga un golpe crítico.
razor-claw.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sharply hooked claw increases the holder’s critical-hit ratio.
razor-claw.efectoItemEN: Held: Raises the holder’s critical hit counter by 1. Held by Sneasel: Evolves the holder into Weavile when it levels up during the night.

razor-fang.descES: Si lo lleva un Pokémon, puede amedrentar al objetivo al infligirle daño.
razor-fang.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.
razor-fang.efectoItemEN: Held: When the holder attacks with most damaging moves, provides an extra 11.7% (30/256) chance for the target to flinch. Held by Gligar: Evolves the holder into Gliscor when it levels up.

tm01.descEN: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
tm01.efectoItemEN: Teaches Focus Punch to a compatible Pokémon.

tm02.descES: Arroja monedas al objetivo y las recupera al final del combate.
tm02.descEN: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.
tm02.efectoItemEN: Teaches Dragon Claw to a compatible Pokémon.

tm03.descES: Puñetazo ardiente que puede causar quemaduras.
tm03.descEN: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This may also leave the target with a burn.
tm03.efectoItemEN: Teaches Water Pulse to a compatible Pokémon.

tm04.descES: Puñetazo helado que puede llegar a congelar.
tm04.descEN: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target frozen.
tm04.efectoItemEN: Teaches Calm Mind to a compatible Pokémon.

tm05.descES: Puñetazo eléctrico que puede paralizar al adversario.
tm05.descEN: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
tm05.efectoItemEN: Teaches Roar to a compatible Pokémon.

tm06.descES: El usuario vuela en el primer turno y ataca en el segundo.
tm06.descEN: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.
tm06.efectoItemEN: Teaches Toxic to a compatible Pokémon.

tm07.descES: Lanza finas púas que hieren de dos a cinco veces.
tm07.descEN: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
tm07.efectoItemEN: Teaches Hail to a compatible Pokémon.

tm08.descES: Es eficaz, pero el atacante deberá descansar en el siguiente turno.
tm08.descEN: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.
tm08.efectoItemEN: Teaches Bulk Up to a compatible Pokémon.

tm09.descES: El usuario carga contra el objetivo con toda la fuerza que tiene y descansa durante el siguiente turno.
tm09.descEN: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.
tm09.efectoItemEN: Teaches Bullet Seed to a compatible Pokémon.

tm10.descES: Esparce extrañas hojas que persiguen al objetivo. No se puede esquivar.
tm10.descEN: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.
tm10.efectoItemEN: Teaches Hidden Power to a compatible Pokémon.

tm11.descES: El usuario absorbe luz en el primer turno y en el segundo lanza un potente rayo de energía.
tm11.descEN: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
tm11.efectoItemEN: Teaches Sunny Day to a compatible Pokémon.

tm12.descES: El usuario dedica un turno a absorber energía lumínica y concentrarla en forma de cuchilla con la que ataca al rival en el siguiente turno.
tm12.descEN: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light’s energy, attacking the target on the next turn.
tm12.efectoItemEN: Teaches Taunt to a compatible Pokémon.

tm13.descES: Un aro de fuego que atrapa al objetivo de cuatro a cinco turnos.
tm13.descEN: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.
tm13.efectoItemEN: Teaches Ice Beam to a compatible Pokémon.

tm14.descES: Una ligera descarga que paraliza al objetivo si lo alcanza.
tm14.descEN: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.
tm14.efectoItemEN: Teaches Blizzard to a compatible Pokémon.

tm15.descES: El usuario cava durante el primer turno y ataca en el segundo.
tm15.descEN: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.
tm15.efectoItemEN: Teaches Hyper Beam to a compatible Pokémon.

tm16.descES: Alarido agudo que reduce mucho la Defensa del objetivo.
tm16.descEN: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.
tm16.efectoItemEN: Teaches Light Screen to a compatible Pokémon.

tm17.descES: Pared de luz que reduce durante cinco turnos el daño producido por los ataques especiales.
tm17.descEN: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.
tm17.efectoItemEN: Teaches Protect to a compatible Pokémon.

tm18.descES: Pared de luz que reduce durante cinco turnos el daño producido por los ataques físicos.
tm18.descEN: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.
tm18.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rain Dance to a compatible Pokémon.

tm19.descES: Un escudo que protege de problemas de estado, como el sueño o la parálisis, durante cinco turnos.
tm19.descEN: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
tm19.efectoItemEN: Teaches Giga Drain to a compatible Pokémon.

tm20.descES: El atacante explota y hiere a todos a su alrededor. El usuario se debilita de inmediato.
tm20.descEN: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
tm20.efectoItemEN: Teaches Safeguard to a compatible Pokémon.

tm21.descES: Restaura todos los PS y cura todos los problemas de estado del usuario, que se duerme los dos turnos siguientes.
tm21.descEN: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.
tm21.efectoItemEN: Teaches Frustration to a compatible Pokémon.

tm22.descES: Lanza grandes pedruscos. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
tm22.descEN: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.
tm22.efectoItemEN: Teaches SolarBeam to a compatible Pokémon.

tm23.descES: El agresor ataca y le quita el objeto al objetivo siempre y cuando no lleve ninguno.
tm23.descEN: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.
tm23.efectoItemEN: Teaches Iron Tail to a compatible Pokémon.

tm24.descES: Fuerte ronquido que solo puede usarse dormido. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.
tm24.descEN: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
tm24.efectoItemEN: Teaches Thunderbolt to a compatible Pokémon.

tm25.descES: Frena todos los ataques, pero puede fallar si se usa repetidamente.
tm25.descEN: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
tm25.efectoItemEN: Teaches Thunder to a compatible Pokémon.

tm26.descES: Asusta al objetivo para reducir mucho su Velocidad.
tm26.descEN: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.
tm26.efectoItemEN: Teaches Earthquake to a compatible Pokémon.

tm27.descES: Ataque con aire helado que baja la Velocidad de los rivales.
tm27.descEN: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.
tm27.efectoItemEN: Teaches Return to a compatible Pokémon.

tm28.descES: Un ataque que absorbe nutrientes. Quien lo usa recupera la mitad de los PS del daño que produce.
tm28.descEN: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
tm28.efectoItemEN: Teaches Dig to a compatible Pokémon.

tm29.descES: Engatusa al objetivo y reduce mucho su Ataque.
tm29.descEN: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target’s Attack stat.
tm29.efectoItemEN: Teaches Psychic to a compatible Pokémon.

tm30.descES: Alas macizas que golpean al objetivo y pueden subir la Defensa del usuario.
tm30.descEN: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.
tm30.efectoItemEN: Teaches Shadow Ball to a compatible Pokémon.

tm31.descES: Si el objetivo es del sexo opuesto, se enamorará y bajará la posibilidad de que ataque.
tm31.descEN: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
tm31.efectoItemEN: Teaches Brick Break to a compatible Pokémon.

tm32.descES: Tormenta de arena que dura cinco turnos y hiere a todos, excepto a los de tipo Roca, Tierra y Acero, y aumenta la Defensa Especial de los de tipo Roca.
tm32.descEN: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.
tm32.efectoItemEN: Teaches Double Team to a compatible Pokémon.

tm33.descES: Genera una fuerte lluvia que refuerza los movimientos de tipo Agua durante cinco turnos y debilita los de tipo Fuego.
tm33.descEN: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.
tm33.efectoItemEN: Teaches Reflect to a compatible Pokémon.

tm34.descES: Hace que se intensifique el efecto del sol durante cinco turnos, lo que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego y debilita los de tipo Agua.
tm34.descEN: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.
tm34.efectoItemEN: Teaches Shock Wave to a compatible Pokémon.

tm35.descES: Tormenta de granizo que dura cinco turnos. Hiere a todos los Pokémon excepto a los de tipo Hielo.
tm35.descEN: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.
tm35.efectoItemEN: Teaches Flamethrower to a compatible Pokémon.

tm36.descES: Una tromba de agua atrapa al objetivo durante cuatro o cinco turnos.
tm36.descEN: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.
tm36.efectoItemEN: Teaches Sludge Bomb to a compatible Pokémon.

tm37.descES: Ataque de todo el equipo Pokémon. Cuantos más haya, más veces se atacará.
tm37.descEN: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
tm37.efectoItemEN: Teaches Sandstorm to a compatible Pokémon.

tm38.descES: Siniestra llama morada que produce quemaduras.
tm38.descEN: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
tm38.efectoItemEN: Teaches Fire Blast to a compatible Pokémon.

tm39.descES: Si el usuario está quemado, paralizado o envenenado, ataca con el doble de potencia.
tm39.descEN: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
tm39.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rock Tomb to a compatible Pokémon.

tm40.descES: Lanza rayos en forma de estrella que no fallan nunca.
tm40.descEN: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
tm40.efectoItemEN: Teaches Aerial Ace to a compatible Pokémon.

tm41.descES: El usuario ayuda a un aliado reforzando la potencia de su ataque.
tm41.descEN: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally’s attack.
tm41.efectoItemEN: Teaches Torment to a compatible Pokémon.

tm42.descES: Ataque que produce el doble de daño si el usuario resulta herido en el mismo turno.
tm42.descEN: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
tm42.efectoItemEN: Teaches Facade to a compatible Pokémon.

tm43.descES: Potente ataque que también es capaz de destruir barreras como Pantalla de Luz y Reflejo.
tm43.descEN: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
tm43.efectoItemEN: Teaches Secret Power to a compatible Pokémon.

tm44.descES: Impide a los contrincantes usar ataques conocidos por el usuario durante el combate.
tm44.descEN: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.
tm44.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rest to a compatible Pokémon.

tm45.descES: El usuario se sumerge en el primer turno y ataca en el segundo.
tm45.descEN: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.
tm45.efectoItemEN: Teaches Attract to a compatible Pokémon.

tm46.descES: El tipo y fuerza del ataque varían según el tiempo que haga.
tm46.descEN: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.
tm46.efectoItemEN: Teaches Thief to a compatible Pokémon.

tm47.descES: Lágrimas de cocodrilo que bajan mucho la Defensa Especial del objetivo.
tm47.descEN: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.
tm47.efectoItemEN: Teaches Steel Wing to a compatible Pokémon.

tm48.descES: Tira rocas que detienen al objetivo y bajan su Velocidad.
tm48.descEN: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.
tm48.efectoItemEN: Teaches Skill Swap to a compatible Pokémon.

tm49.descES: Enreda al objetivo en un remolino de arena de cuatro a cinco turnos.
tm49.descEN: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.
tm49.efectoItemEN: Teaches Snatch to a compatible Pokémon.

tm50.descES: Dispara rápido de dos a cinco ráfagas de semillas de manera consecutiva.
tm50.descEN: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two to five times in a row.
tm50.efectoItemEN: Teaches Overheat to a compatible Pokémon.

tm51.descES: Ataca lanzando de dos a cinco ráfagas consecutivas de carámbanos.
tm51.descEN: The user launches sharp icicles at the target two to five times in a row.
tm51.efectoItemEN: Teaches Roost to a compatible Pokémon.

tm52.descES: El usuario bota en el primer turno y golpea al objetivo en el segundo y puede llegar a paralizarlo.
tm52.descEN: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
tm52.efectoItemEN: Teaches Focus Blast to a compatible Pokémon.

tm53.descES: El usuario lanza lodo al objetivo y reduce su Velocidad.
tm53.descEN: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.
tm53.efectoItemEN: Teaches Energy Ball to a compatible Pokémon.

tm54.descES: Lanza pedruscos al objetivo de dos a cinco veces consecutivas.
tm54.descEN: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in a row.
tm54.efectoItemEN: Teaches False Swipe to a compatible Pokémon.

tm55.descES: Si al objetivo le queda la mitad o menos de sus PS, el ataque será el doble de fuerte.
tm55.descEN: If the target’s HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.
tm55.efectoItemEN: Teaches Brine to a compatible Pokémon.

tm56.descES: Tras atacar, el usuario vuelve a toda prisa para dar paso a otro Pokémon del equipo.
tm56.descEN: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
tm56.efectoItemEN: Teaches Fling to a compatible Pokémon.

tm57.descES: El usuario contraataca con el doble de fuerza si el objetivo usa un movimiento antes.
tm57.descEN: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.
tm57.efectoItemEN: Teaches Charge Beam to a compatible Pokémon.

tm58.descES: Si el objetivo ya ha sufrido daño en ese turno, la fuerza del ataque se duplica.
tm58.descEN: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.
tm58.efectoItemEN: Teaches Endure to a compatible Pokémon.

tm59.descES: El usuario lanza contra el objetivo el objeto que lleva. La fuerza del ataque y su efecto varían según el objeto.
tm59.descEN: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.
tm59.efectoItemEN: Teaches Dragon Pulse to a compatible Pokémon.

tm60.descES: El usuario emplea su poder mental para intercambiar los cambios en el Ataque y Ataque Especial con el objetivo.
tm60.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
tm60.efectoItemEN: Teaches Drain Punch to a compatible Pokémon.

tm61.descES: El usuario emplea su poder mental para intercambiar los cambios en la Defensa y Defensa Especial con el objetivo.
tm61.descEN: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
tm61.efectoItemEN: Teaches Will-O-Wisp to a compatible Pokémon.

tm62.descES: Intercambia su Velocidad por la del oponente.
tm62.descEN: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
tm62.efectoItemEN: Teaches Silver Wind to a compatible Pokémon.

tm63.descES: Un golpe que drena energía. El Pokémon recupera la mitad de los PS arrebatados al objetivo.
tm63.descEN: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
tm63.efectoItemEN: Teaches Embargo to a compatible Pokémon.

tm64.descES: Este ataque inflige el doble de daño a un objetivo que haya golpeado al usuario en ese mismo turno.
tm64.descEN: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.
tm64.efectoItemEN: Teaches Explosion to a compatible Pokémon.

tm65.descES: Ataca con una garra afilada hecha de sombras. Suele ser crítico.
tm65.descEN: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
tm65.efectoItemEN: Teaches Shadow Claw to a compatible Pokémon.

tm66.descES: El usuario muerde al objetivo con colmillos electrificados y puede hacer que se amedrente o se paralice.
tm66.descEN: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
tm66.efectoItemEN: Teaches Payback to a compatible Pokémon.

tm67.descES: El usuario muerde al objetivo con colmillos helados y puede hacer que se amedrente o se congele.
tm67.descEN: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
tm67.efectoItemEN: Teaches Recycle to a compatible Pokémon.

tm68.descES: El usuario muerde al objetivo con colmillos en llamas y puede hacer que se amedrente o sufra quemaduras.
tm68.descEN: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.
tm68.efectoItemEN: Teaches Giga Impact to a compatible Pokémon.

tm69.descES: Ataca al objetivo con cuchillas formadas por energía psíquica. Suele ser crítico.
tm69.descEN: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.
tm69.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rock Polish to a compatible Pokémon.

tm70.descES: Crea un espacio extraño en el que los Pokémon lentos se mueven primero durante cinco turnos.
tm70.descEN: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
tm70.efectoItemEN: Teaches Flash to a compatible Pokémon.

tm71.descES: Crea una zona misteriosa donde se intercambian la Defensa y la Defensa Especial de todos los Pokémon durante cinco turnos.
tm71.descEN: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
tm71.efectoItemEN: Teaches Stone Edge to a compatible Pokémon.

tm72.descES: Crea un espacio misterioso que inutiliza todos los objetos de los Pokémon durante cinco turnos.
tm72.descEN: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose their effects for five turns.
tm72.efectoItemEN: Teaches Avalanche to a compatible Pokémon.

tm73.descES: Tajo que puede envenenar al objetivo. Suele ser crítico.
tm73.descEN: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.
tm73.efectoItemEN: Teaches Thunder Wave to a compatible Pokémon.

tm74.descES: Cubre al objetivo con un líquido venenoso. El daño será doble si este ya está envenenado.
tm74.descEN: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
tm74.efectoItemEN: Teaches Gyro Ball to a compatible Pokémon.

tm75.descES: Ataque rápido dirigido a los pies del objetivo que le hace perder Velocidad.
tm75.descEN: The user makes a swift attack on the target’s legs, which lowers the target’s Speed stat.
tm75.efectoItemEN: Teaches Swords Dance to a compatible Pokémon.

tm76.descES: Un canto que ataca al objetivo. Cuantos más Pokémon lo usan, más aumenta de potencia.
tm76.descEN: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.
tm76.efectoItemEN: Teaches Stealth Rock to a compatible Pokémon.

tm77.descES: Ataque que causa un gran daño a los objetivos que sufren problemas de estado.
tm77.descEN: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.
tm77.efectoItemEN: Teaches Psych Up to a compatible Pokémon.

tm78.descES: Golpea ágilmente. Si el usuario no porta ningún objeto, el objetivo resulta seriamente dañado.
tm78.descEN: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.
tm78.efectoItemEN: Teaches Captivate to a compatible Pokémon.

tm79.descES: Venga a los amigos caídos. Si en el turno anterior han derrotado a alguno, la potencia del ataque aumentará.
tm79.descEN: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this move’s power is increased.
tm79.efectoItemEN: Teaches Dark Pulse to a compatible Pokémon.

tm80.descES: Tras atacar, el usuario vuelve a toda prisa para dar paso a otro Pokémon del equipo.
tm80.descEN: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
tm80.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rock Slide to a compatible Pokémon.

tm81.descES: Sacudida sísmica que afecta a los demás Pokémon adyacentes y también reduce su Velocidad.
tm81.descEN: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
tm81.efectoItemEN: Teaches X-Scissor to a compatible Pokémon.

tm82.descES: Atrapa y ataca a los objetivos con una telaraña eléctrica. También reduce su Velocidad.
tm82.descEN: The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stats.
tm82.efectoItemEN: Teaches Sleep Talk to a compatible Pokémon.

tm83.descES: Una afilada vieira ataca al objetivo. También puede hacer disminuir su Defensa.
tm83.descEN: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
tm83.efectoItemEN: Teaches Natural Gift to a compatible Pokémon.

tm84.descES: Golpea con la cola de dos a cinco veces seguidas.
tm84.descEN: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.
tm84.efectoItemEN: Teaches Poison Jab to a compatible Pokémon.

tm85.descES: Chillido desagradable que baja el Ataque Especial del rival.
tm85.descEN: The user yells as if it’s ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.
tm85.efectoItemEN: Teaches Dream Eater to a compatible Pokémon.

tm86.descES: El usuario desaparece en el primer turno y ataca a su objetivo en el segundo. Permite acertar aunque el objetivo esté protegiéndose.
tm86.descEN: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
tm86.efectoItemEN: Teaches Grass Knot to a compatible Pokémon.

tm87.descES: El usuario absorbe PS del objetivo con un beso y restaura su propia energía en una cantidad igual o superior a la mitad del daño infligido.
tm87.descEN: The user steals the target’s HP with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
tm87.efectoItemEN: Teaches Swagger to a compatible Pokémon.

tm88.descES: Durante cinco turnos, se potencian los movimientos de tipo Planta y los Pokémon que están en contacto con el suelo recuperan PS en cada turno.
tm88.descEN: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.
tm88.efectoItemEN: Teaches Pluck to a compatible Pokémon.

tm89.descES: Durante cinco turnos, los Pokémon que están en el suelo no sufren problemas de estado y se reduce a la mitad el daño de los movimientos de tipo Dragón.
tm89.descEN: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
tm89.efectoItemEN: Teaches U-Turn to a compatible Pokémon.

tm90.descES: Durante cinco turnos, se potencian los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico y los Pokémon que están en contacto con el suelo no pueden quedarse dormidos.
tm90.descEN: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.
tm90.efectoItemEN: Teaches Substitute to a compatible Pokémon.

tm91.descES: Durante cinco turnos, se potencian los movimientos de tipo Psíquico y los Pokémon que están en el suelo quedan protegidos contra movimientos con prioridad.
tm91.descEN: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
tm91.efectoItemEN: Teaches Flash Cannon to a compatible Pokémon.

tm92.descES: El usuario lanza por la boca una singular llama a gran temperatura con la que ataca a su oponente y baja su Ataque Especial.
tm92.descEN: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
tm92.efectoItemEN: Teaches Trick Room to a compatible Pokémon.

hm01.descES: Corta al objetivo con una cuchilla o garra. También puede usarse para cortar árboles finos.
hm01.descEN: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. This can also be used to cut down thin trees.
hm01.efectoItemEN: Teaches Cut to a compatible Pokémon.

hm02.descES: Quien lo usa levanta el vuelo y ataca en el siguiente turno. También se puede usar para volar a algún sitio conocido.
hm02.descEN: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn. This can also be used to fly to any familiar town.
hm02.efectoItemEN: Teaches Fly to a compatible Pokémon.

hm03.descES: Inunda el terreno de combate con una ola gigante.
hm03.descEN: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
hm03.efectoItemEN: Teaches Surf to a compatible Pokémon.

hm04.descES: Genera mucha fuerza y ataca con gran energía al objetivo. También puede usarse para mover piedras grandes.
hm04.descEN: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. This can also be used to move heavy boulders.
hm04.efectoItemEN: Teaches Strength to a compatible Pokémon.

hm05.descES: Carga contra el objetivo a una velocidad increíble. También puede usarse para remontar una cascada.
hm05.descEN: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. This can also be used to climb a waterfall.
hm05.efectoItemEN: Teaches Defog to a compatible Pokémon.

hm06.descES: Ataca con los puños. Puede bajar la Defensa del objetivo y romper rocas fuera del combate.
hm06.descEN: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat. This move can also shatter rocks in the field.
hm06.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rock Smash to a compatible Pokémon.

hm07.descES: Ataca sumergiéndose en el agua en el primer turno y emergiendo violentamente en el segundo.
hm07.descEN: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.
hm07.efectoItemEN: Teaches Waterfall to a compatible Pokémon.

hm08.descEN: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.
hm08.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rock Climb to a compatible Pokémon.

explorer-kit.descES: Una saca donde guardar los objetos útiles para la exploración. Permite acceder al Subsuelo.
explorer-kit.descEN: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground in the Sinnoh region.
explorer-kit.efectoItemEN: Sends the trainer to the Underground. Only usable outside.

loot-sack.descES: Una saca grande y resistente utilizada para transportar el botín reunido en la mina de carbón.
loot-sack.descEN: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry any treasures or loot obtained in the coal mine.

rule-book.descES: Recoge las normas de los combates. En los combates en conexión puedes elegir el conjunto de reglas que quieres usar.
rule-book.descEN: It lists the rules for holding battles. For Link Battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

poke-radar.descES: Busca Pokémon que se esconden en la hierba. La batería se recarga mientras caminas.
poke-radar.descEN: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in the tall grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.
poke-radar.efectoItemEN: Designates several nearby patches of grass as containing Pokémon, some of which may be special radar-only Pokémon. Successive uses in a certain way create chains of encounters with the same species; longer chains increase the chance that a shiny Pokémon of that species will appear.

point-card.descES: Una tarjeta en la que se registran los Puntos de Batalla que has ganado.
point-card.descEN: A card that lists how many Battle Points you have earned.

journal.descES: Un cuaderno en el que se recogen, día a día, los progresos de tu aventura.
journal.descEN: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.
journal.efectoItemEN: Records some of the trainer’s activities for the day.

seal-case.descES: Caja en la que se pueden guardar los sellos que se aplican a las cápsulas de las Poké Balls.
seal-case.descEN: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the exteriors of Poké Balls.
seal-case.efectoItemEN: Contains Seals used for decorating Pokéballs.

fashion-case.descES: Una bonita cajita donde guardar todos los Complementos para vestir a tus Pokémon en el Teatro Musical.
fashion-case.descEN: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

seal-bag.descES: Bolsita con capacidad para diez sellos de los que decoran las Poké Balls.
seal-bag.descEN: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

pal-pad.descES: Un cuaderno muy práctico en el que puedes registrar amigos, claves de amigo, etc.
pal-pad.descEN: A convenient notepad that is used to register your friends and friend codes and keep a record of your gameplay.
pal-pad.efectoItemEN: Contains friend codes for up to 32 other players, as well as their sprite, gender, and basic statistics for those that have been seen on WFC.

works-key.descES: Abre la puerta de la Central del Valle Eólico. La llevaba un Recluta del Equipo Galaxia.
works-key.descEN: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.
works-key.efectoItemEN: Opens the front door of the Valley Windworks. Reusable.

old-charm.descES: Está hecho con huesos de Pokémon y trae buena suerte. Hay que llevárselo a la anciana de Pueblo Caelestis.
old-charm.descEN: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.
old-charm.efectoItemEN: Given to Cynthia’s grandmother to get the Surf HM.

galactic-key.descES: Desactiva los sistemas de seguridad de la Base Galaxia. Por lo visto, perder esta tarjeta se castiga severamente.
galactic-key.descEN: A card key for disengaging the security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.
galactic-key.efectoItemEN: Grants access to Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.

red-chain.descES: Se dice que esta cadena mística está relacionada con el Pokémon legendario que creó la región de Sinnoh.
red-chain.descEN: A mythical chain that is said to link the Legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

town-map.descES: Un mapa muy útil que puede consultarse en cualquier momento y que, además, te indica dónde te encuentras.
town-map.descEN: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.
town-map.efectoItemEN: Displays a map of the region including the trainer’s position, location names, visited towns, gym locations, and where the trainer has been walking recently.

vs-seeker.descES: Dispositivo que busca Entrenadores listos para el combate. La batería se carga mientras caminas.
vs-seeker.descEN: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.
vs-seeker.efectoItemEN: Reveals trainers who want a rematch, by showing !! over their heads. Each use drains the battery; requires 100 steps to charge.

coin-case.descES: Puedes obtenerlo en la Sala de Juegos. Tiene capacidad para 50 000 fichas.
coin-case.descEN: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.
coin-case.efectoItemEN: Contains the Coins used by the Game Corner, to a maximum of 50,000.

old-rod.descES: Caña de pescar bastante usada y desgastada. Pesca Pokémon salvajes en todo tipo de aguas.
old-rod.descEN: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
old-rod.efectoItemEN: Used to find Pokémon on the Old Rod list for an area, which are generally Magikarp or similar.

good-rod.descES: Caña de pescar nuevecita y de gran calidad. Pesca Pokémon salvajes en todo tipo de aguas.
good-rod.descEN: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
good-rod.efectoItemEN: Used to find Pokémon on the Good Rod list for an area, which are generally mediocre.

super-rod.descES: Increíble caña de pescar de alta tecnología. Pesca Pokémon salvajes en todo tipo de aguas.
super-rod.descEN: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
super-rod.efectoItemEN: Used to find Pokémon on the Super Rod list for an area, which are generally the best available there.

sprayduck.descES: Una regadera con forma de Psyduck. Ayuda a que las bayas plantadas en suelo fértil crezcan mejor.
sprayduck.descEN: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

poffin-case.descES: Caja en la que se transportan los Pokochos elaborados con bayas.
poffin-case.descEN: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.

bicycle.descEN: A folding Bicycle that enables a rider to get around much faster than a pair of Running Shoes will allow.
bicycle.efectoItemEN: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. In high gear, allows the trainer to hop over some rocks and ascend muddy slopes.

suite-key.descES: Llave de una suite del hotel de lujo junto al lago. Por algún motivo, se pierde a menudo.
suite-key.descEN: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.
suite-key.efectoItemEN: Opens the locked building in the lakeside resort.

oaks-letter.descES: Carta del Profesor Oak en la que se te pide que vayas a la Ruta 224.
oaks-letter.descEN: A letter from Professor Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Route 224.
oaks-letter.efectoItemEN: Grants access to Flower Paradise and Shaymin.

lunar-wing.descES: Pluma que brilla como la luna. Se dice que tiene el poder de disipar pesadillas.
lunar-wing.descEN: A feather that glows like the moon. It’s said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.
lunar-wing.efectoItemEN: Cures the sailor’s son of his nightmares; no reward, only a side effect of seeing Cresselia.

member-card.descES: Necesario para entrar en la posada de Ciudad Canal. Es extraño, pero la última fecha registrada es de hace 50 años.
member-card.descEN: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.
member-card.efectoItemEN: Provides access to Newmoon Island and Darkrai.

azure-flute.descES: Emite sonidos que no parecen de este mundo. Es de fabricante desconocido.
azure-flute.descEN: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. No one knows who made it.
azure-flute.efectoItemEN: Allows entry into the Hall of Origin. Unreleased.

ss-ticket.descES: Es el billete válido para embarcar en el Ferry S.S. Aqua. Tiene dibujado un barco.
ss-ticket.descEN: A ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on its front.
ss-ticket.efectoItemEN: Allows passage on a ferry. The same item is used for different ferries between different games.

contest-pass.descES: Es necesario para participar en Concursos Pokémon. Tiene una cinta de ganador dibujada.
contest-pass.descEN: A pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on its front.
contest-pass.efectoItemEN: Allows the trainer to enter Contests.

magma-stone.descES: Formada a partir de magma enfriado y endurecido. Aún hay magma líquido en su interior.
magma-stone.descEN: A stone formed by boulders melting in intensely hot magma, then hardening. Magma remains sealed inside it.
magma-stone.efectoItemEN: Causes Heatran to appear at Reversal Mountain. Unused prior to Black and White 2.

parcel.descES: Paquete encomendado a tu cuidado que tienes que entregar a tu amigo de la infancia que dejó Pueblo Hojaverde.
parcel.descEN: A parcel entrusted into your care. You’re supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.
parcel.efectoItemEN: Given to the trainer’s rival in Jubilife City. Contains two Town Maps, one of which is given to the trainer upon delivery.

coupon-1.descES: Uno de los tres cupones que sirve para obtener un Poké-reloj.
coupon-1.descEN: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
coupon-1.efectoItemEN: One of three coupons needed to receive a Pokétch.

coupon-2.descES: Uno de los tres cupones que sirve para obtener un Poké-reloj.
coupon-2.descEN: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
coupon-2.efectoItemEN: One of three coupons needed to receive a Pokétch.

coupon-3.descES: Uno de los tres cupones que sirve para obtener un Poké-reloj.
coupon-3.descEN: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.
coupon-3.efectoItemEN: One of three coupons needed to receive a Pokétch.

storage-key.descES: Llave del siniestro almacén del Equipo Galaxia que está ubicado en las afueras de Ciudad Rocavelo.
storage-key.descEN: The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.
storage-key.efectoItemEN: Grants access to the Team Galactic warehouse in Veilstone City.

secret-potion.descES: Fantástico medicamento vendido en la farmacia de Ciudad Orquídea. Cura completamente a un Pokémon.
secret-potion.descEN: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.
secret-potion.efectoItemEN: Required to cure the Psyducks blocking Route 210 of their chronic headaches.

griseous-orb.descES: Una esfera brillante que potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón y Fantasma. Debe llevarla Giratina.
griseous-orb.descEN: A glowing orb to be held by Giratina. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Ghost-type moves when it is held.
griseous-orb.efectoItemEN: Held by Giratina : Holder’s Dragon and Ghost moves have 1.2× their base power. Holder is in Origin Forme. This item cannot be held by any Pokémon but Giratina. When you enter the Union Room or connect to Wi-Fi, this item returns to your bag.

vs-recorder.descES: Un fantástico dispositivo que graba combates entre amigos o celebrados en algún recinto especial.
vs-recorder.descEN: An amazing device that can record a battle between friends or the battles at certain special battle facilities.
vs-recorder.efectoItemEN: Optionally records wireless, Wi-Fi, and Battle Frontier battles. Tracks Battle Points earned in the Battle Frontier, and stores commemorative prints.

gracidea.descES: Una flor que se suele regalar en ramos para expresar agradecimiento en ocasiones especiales, como cumpleaños.
gracidea.descEN: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays.
gracidea.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer on a Shaymin : Changes the target Shaymin from Land Forme to Sky Forme. This item cannot be used on a frozen Shaymin or at night. Sky Forme Shaymin will revert to Land Forme overnight, when frozen, and upon entering a link battle. This item must be used again to change it back.

secret-key.descES: Una llave de alta tecnología que debe usarse en un lugar concreto. Emite una señal eléctrica que abre una puerta.
secret-key.descEN: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electronic signal to open a door.
secret-key.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer in the Galactic Eterna Building, on the ground floor, to the left of the TV : Unlocks the secret Rotom room, in which there are five appliances which can change Rotom’s form.

apricorn-box.descES: Práctico recipiente que puede almacenar hasta 99 Bonguri de cada especie.
apricorn-box.descEN: A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each kind of Apricorn.

berry-pots.descES: Dispositivo portátil de cultivo que permite plantar bayas en cualquier momento de forma sencilla.
berry-pots.descEN: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.
berry-pots.efectoItemEN: Contains four portable pots of soil suitable for growing berries.

squirt-bottle.descES: Objeto que contiene agua y se usa para regar las bayas del Plantabayas.
squirt-bottle.descEN: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.
squirt-bottle.efectoItemEN: Required to water berries within the Berry Pots. Required to battle the Sudowoodo on Route 36. This item cannot be directly used from the bag.

lure-ball.descES: Poké Ball algo distinta, especialmente indicada para capturar los Pokémon que se han pescado con una caña.
lure-ball.descEN: A Poké Ball that is good for catching Pokémon that you reel in with a rod while out fishing.
lure-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon was encountered by fishing, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 3× normal.

level-ball.descES: Poké Ball algo distinta que funciona especialmente bien con Pokémon de nivel inferior a los que se posee.
level-ball.descEN: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are at a lower level than your own Pokémon.
level-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the trainer’s Pokémon’s level is higher than: * four times the wild Pokémon’s, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 8× normal. * than twice the wild Pokémon’s, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 4× normal. * the wild Pokémon’s, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 2× normal.

moon-ball.descES: Poké Ball algo distinta que atrapa con más facilidad los Pokémon que evolucionan con la Piedra Lunar.
moon-ball.descEN: A Poké Ball that will make it easier to catch Pokémon that can evolve using a Moon Stone.
moon-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon is a Clefairy, Nidoran♂, Nidoran♀, Jigglypuff, Skitty, or any evolution thereof, the wild Pokémon has 4× its catch rate.

heavy-ball.descES: Poké Ball algo distinta que funciona especialmente bien a la hora de atrapar Pokémon de mucho peso.
heavy-ball.descEN: A Poké Ball that is better than usual at catching very heavy Pokémon.
heavy-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon weighs: * 409.6 kg (903.0 lb) or more, its catch rate is 40 more than normal. * 307.2 kg (677.3 lb) or more, its catch rate is 30 more than normal. * 204.8 kg (451.5 lb) or more, its catch rate is 20 more than normal. * less than 204.8 kg (451.5 lb), its catch rate is 20 less than normal.

fast-ball.descES: Poké Ball algo distinta, especialmente indicada para capturar Pokémon evasivos.
fast-ball.descEN: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are usually very quick to run away.
fast-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. : If the wild Pokémon’s base speed is 100 or more, its catch rate is 4× normal.

friend-ball.descES: Poké Ball algo distinta que hace más amistosos a los Pokémon salvajes que se capturan con ella.
friend-ball.descEN: A strange Poké Ball that will make the wild Pokémon caught with it more friendly toward you immediately.
friend-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If caught, the wild Pokémon’s happiness starts at 200.

love-ball.descES: Poké Ball algo distinta que atrapa mejor Pokémon de la misma especie que los que se posee, pero de sexo diferente.
love-ball.descEN: A Poké Ball that works best when catching a Pokémon that is of the opposite gender of your Pokémon.
love-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the trainer’s Pokémon and wild Pokémon are of the same species but opposite genders, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 8× normal.

park-ball.descES: Poké Ball que se utiliza dentro del Parque Compi.
park-ball.descEN: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.
park-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by a trainer in battle : Catches a wild Pokémon. This item can only be used in Pal Park.

sport-ball.descES: Poké Ball especial que se utilizaba en el Concurso de Captura de Bichos de la región de Johto.
sport-ball.descEN: A special Poké Ball that was used during the Bug-Catching Contest in the Johto region.
sport-ball.efectoItemEN: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. The wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 1.5× normal.

red-apricorn.descES: Bonguri de color rojo y aroma muy penetrante.
red-apricorn.descEN: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.
red-apricorn.efectoItemEN: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Level Ball.

blue-apricorn.descES: Bonguri de color azul y aroma tierno.
blue-apricorn.descEN: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.
blue-apricorn.efectoItemEN: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Lure Ball.

yellow-apricorn.descES: Bonguri de color amarillo y aroma refrescante.
yellow-apricorn.descEN: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.
yellow-apricorn.efectoItemEN: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Moon Ball.

green-apricorn.descES: Bonguri de color verde y aroma peculiar que recuerda al café tostado.
green-apricorn.descEN: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.
green-apricorn.efectoItemEN: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Friend Ball.

pink-apricorn.descES: Bonguri de color rosa y aroma dulce.
pink-apricorn.descEN: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.
pink-apricorn.efectoItemEN: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Love Ball.

white-apricorn.descES: Bonguri de color blanco que no desprende aroma alguno.
white-apricorn.descEN: A white Apricorn. It doesn’t smell like anything.
white-apricorn.efectoItemEN: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Fast Ball.

black-apricorn.descES: Bonguri de color negro y aroma indescriptible.
black-apricorn.descEN: A black Apricorn. It has a scent beyond one’s experience.
black-apricorn.efectoItemEN: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Heavy Ball.

dowsing-machine.descES: Aparato de precisión que reacciona ante objetos que no se ven. Para usarlo, es necesario colocárselo en la cabeza.
dowsing-machine.descEN: A high-tech machine that shows the location of invisible items. It’s attached to the head when in use.
dowsing-machine.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer outside of battle : Searches for hidden items.

rage-candy-bar.descES: Caramelo típico de Pueblo Caoba. Cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
rage-candy-bar.descEN: Mahogany Town’s famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
rage-candy-bar.efectoItemEN: May be traded for a TM64 in the vertical Underground Path.

red-orb.descES: Piedra carmesí de la que se dice que guarda una estrecha relación con las leyendas de Hoenn.
red-orb.descEN: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It’s known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
red-orb.efectoItemEN: Causes Groudon to appear in the Embedded Tower.

blue-orb.descES: Piedra añil que, según dicen, guarda una estrecha relación con las leyendas de Hoenn.
blue-orb.descEN: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It’s known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
blue-orb.efectoItemEN: Causes Kyogre to appear in the Embedded Tower.

jade-orb.descES: Esfera glauca de la que se dice que guarda una estrecha relación con las leyendas de Hoenn.
jade-orb.descEN: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It’s known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
jade-orb.efectoItemEN: Causes Rayquaza to appear in the Embedded Tower.

enigma-stone.descES: Esfera cristalina encontrada bajo tierra. A pesar de estar cubierta de roca y tierra, su belleza es increíble.
enigma-stone.descEN: A crystal ball that was excavated from the ground. It’s a very beautiful stone that is covered with bits of rock and earth.
enigma-stone.efectoItemEN: When taken to the Pewter City museum, causes Latias or Latios to attack the trainer. The Pokémon to appear will be whicher can’t be encountered roaming in the wild.

unown-report.descES: Bloc que almacena la información de los Unown capturados hasta el momento.
unown-report.descEN: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.
unown-report.efectoItemEN: Lists which Unown forms the trainer has caught.

blue-card.descES: Tarjeta para conseguir puntos con el programa de radio Las contraseñas de Buena.
blue-card.descEN: A card to save points for the Buena’s Password show.
blue-card.efectoItemEN: Allows the trainer to answer the daily question on Buena’s radio show. Records the points earned for correct answers.

slowpoke-tail.descES: Sabrosa cola de origen desconocido. Se puede comprar a un precio muy elevado.
slowpoke-tail.descEN: A very tasty tail of something. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

clear-bell.descES: Cascabel de aspecto antiguo que emite un sonido que calma el espíritu.
clear-bell.descEN: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.
clear-bell.efectoItemEN: May be given to the Kimono Girls to summon Ho-Oh to the top of the Bell Tower.

card-key.descES: Llave con forma de tarjeta que abre las puertas de la Torre Radio.
card-key.descEN: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.
card-key.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer outside of battle : Opens doors in the Goldenrod City Radio Tower.

basement-key.descES: Llave que abre la puerta que hay en el Túnel Trigal.
basement-key.descEN: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.
basement-key.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer outside of battle : Opens the door to the basement tunnel under Goldenrod City.

red-scale.descES: Escama del Gyarados aparecido en el Lago de la Furia. Es de un rojo tan intenso como las llamas.
red-scale.descEN: A scale from a red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.
red-scale.efectoItemEN: May be traded to Mr. Pokémon for an Exp. Share.

lost-item.descES: El muñeco Mime Jr. que perdió la Copiona.
lost-item.descEN: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.
lost-item.efectoItemEN: May be traded to the Copycat for a Pass.

pass.descES: Billete necesario para poder montar todas las veces que se desee en el Magnetotrén.
pass.descEN: A pass required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you’d like.
pass.efectoItemEN: Allows the trainer to ride the Magnet Train between Goldenrod City and Saffron City.

machine-part.descES: Valiosa pieza robada de una máquina de la Central Energía.
machine-part.descEN: An important part of a machine that was stolen from the Power Plant.
machine-part.efectoItemEN: Must be replaced in the Kanto Power Plant to power the Magnet Train.

silver-wing.descES: Misteriosa ala de un brillante color plateado.
silver-wing.descEN: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.
silver-wing.efectoItemEN: Causes Lugia to appear in the Whirl Islands.

rainbow-wing.descES: Misteriosa ala de un brillante color arcoíris.
rainbow-wing.descEN: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.
rainbow-wing.efectoItemEN: Causes Ho-Oh to appear at the top of Bell Tower.

mystery-egg.descES: Misterioso Huevo con dibujos que obtienes del Sr. Pokémon. Nadie sabe qué contiene.
mystery-egg.descEN: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What is in the Egg is unknown.
mystery-egg.efectoItemEN: Must be obtained to trigger the break-in at Professor Elm’s lab, the first rival battle, and access to Route 31.

gb-sounds.descES: Lector con el que se pueden escuchar aquellas canciones tan nostálgicas. Se cambia con un solo interruptor.
gb-sounds.descEN: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It’s operated with the flip of a single switch.
gb-sounds.efectoItemEN: Used by trainer outside of battle : Changes the background music to the equivalent 8-bit music.

tidal-bell.descES: Cascabel de aspecto antiguo que emite un sonido que calma el espíritu.
tidal-bell.descEN: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing sound.
tidal-bell.efectoItemEN: May be given to the Kimono Girls to summon Lugia to the top of the Bell Tower.

data-card-01.descES: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de victorias.
data-card-01.descEN: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many victories you have had in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-01.efectoItemEN: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first place overall in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-02.descEN: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many losses you have had in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-02.efectoItemEN: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last place overall in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-21.descEN: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you have won a Pokéathlon event.
data-card-21.efectoItemEN: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first across all Pokéathlon events.

data-card-22.efectoItemEN: Records the number of times the trainer has come in last across all Pokéathlon events.

data-card-23.descEN: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you switched Pokémon in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-24.efectoItemEN: Records the number of times the trainer has come in first in the Pokéathlon Goal Roll.

data-card-25.descES: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de premios individuales.
data-card-25.descEN: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times your Pokémon won individual prizes.
data-card-25.efectoItemEN: Records the number of times the trainer’s Pokémon received prizes in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-26.descES: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el número de veces que se tocó con el lápiz a los Pokémon.
data-card-26.descEN: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how many times you instructed your Pokémon.
data-card-26.efectoItemEN: Records the number of times the trainer has instructed Pokémon in the Pokéathlon.

data-card-27.descES: Contiene los datos del Pokéathlon con el tiempo que se ha pasado en esta competición.
data-card-27.descEN: It holds Pokéathlon records. It is a card that shows how much time you spent participating in the Pokéathlon.
data-card-27.efectoItemEN: Records the total time spent in the Pokéathlon.

lock-capsule.descES: Una cápsula resistente que solo puede abrirse con una llave especial.
lock-capsule.descEN: A sturdy Capsule that can only be opened with a special key.

photo-album.descES: Álbum que recoge las fotos que se toman a lo largo de la aventura.
photo-album.descEN: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.

orange-mail.descEN: A piece of MAIL featuring a cute ZIGZAGOON print. It is to be held by a POKéMON.
orange-mail.efectoItemEN: Used to send short messages to other players via Pokémon trading. Trainer may compose a message from a finite list of words when giving this item to a Pokémon. Once taken and read, a message may be erased and this item can be reused, or the message may be stored in the trainer’s PC. Held : Holder cannot be placed in the PC. Any move attempting to remove this item from the holder will fail.
