mach-bike.descES: Bicicleta plegable que va a más del doble de velocidad que otras.
mach-bike.descEN: This folding bike more than doubles your movement speed.
mach-bike.efectoItemEN: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. Faster than the Acro Bike. Allows the trainer to ascend muddy slopes.

acro-bike.descES: Bicicleta plegable capaz de correr sobre una sola rueda, realizar saltos y otras acrobacias.
acro-bike.descEN: This folding bike allows you to perform actions such as wheelies and bunny hops.
acro-bike.efectoItemEN: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. Slower than the Mach Bike. Can perform various tricks, allowing the trainer to reach certain special areas.

wailmer-pail.descES: Regadera con forma de Wailmer. Muy útil para que crezcan las bayas plantadas.
wailmer-pail.descEN: This is a tool for watering Berries you planted to make them grow more quickly.

devon-goods.descEN: A package that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the DEVON CORPORATION.
devon-goods.efectoItemEN: Contains a machine part to be delivered to Captain Stern.

soot-sack.descES: Bolsa en la que recoger la ceniza de volcán sedimentada en el suelo.
soot-sack.descEN: A sack used to gather and hold volcanic ash.
soot-sack.efectoItemEN: Collects soot when walking through tall grass on Route 113.

pokeblock-case.descEN: A case for holding POKéBLOCKS made with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases one POKéBLOCK when shaken.

letter.descES: Carta que te ha confiado el presidente de Devon S. A.
letter.descEN: An extremely important letter to Steven from the president of Devon Corporation.
letter.efectoItemEN: Contains a letter to be delivered to Steven.

eon-ticket.descES: Billete de barco para viajar a Isla del Sur. Es posible que Norman, Líder de Gimnasio de Ciudad Petalia, sepa algo al respecto.
eon-ticket.descEN: The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to the Southern Island. Does Norman, the Petalburg Gym Leader, know a secret?!
eon-ticket.efectoItemEN: Provides access to Southern Island and either Latias or Latios, whichever is not available roaming around Hoenn.

scanner.descES: Objeto hallado en el interior de Malvamar.
scanner.descEN: A device found inside Sea Mauville.
scanner.efectoItemEN: May be traded to Captain Stern for a Deep Sea Tooth or a Deep Sea Scale.

go-goggles.descES: Gafas idóneas para protegerte los ojos de las tormentas de arena del desierto.
go-goggles.descEN: Nifty goggles to protect eyes from desert sandstorms.
go-goggles.efectoItemEN: Allows the trainer to enter the desert on Route 111.

meteorite.descES: Meteorito obtenido en el Monte Cenizo que antes se encontraba en la Cascada Meteoro.
meteorite.descEN: A Meteorite originally found at Meteor Falls. You got it at Mt. Chimney.
meteorite.efectoItemEN: RSE: May be traded to Professor Cozmo for TM27. FRLG: A meteorite to be delivered to Lostelle’s father.

rm-1-key.descEN: A key that opens the door to Room 1 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.
rm-1-key.efectoItemEN: Unlocks room 1 on the Abandoned Ship.

rm-2-key.descEN: A key that opens the door to Room 2 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.
rm-2-key.efectoItemEN: Unlocks room 2 on the Abandoned Ship.

rm-4-key.descEN: A key that opens the door to Room 4 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.
rm-4-key.efectoItemEN: Unlocks room 4 on the Abandoned Ship.

rm-6-key.descEN: A key that opens the door to Room 6 inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.
rm-6-key.efectoItemEN: Unlocks room 6 on the Abandoned Ship.

devon-scope.descES: Artilugio creado por Devon S. A. que reacciona a la presencia de Pokémon invisibles emitiendo sonidos.
devon-scope.descEN: A special device made by Devon Corporation that signals the presence of any unseen Pokémon.
devon-scope.efectoItemEN: Reveals invisble Kecleon on the overworld.

oaks-parcel.descEN: A parcel to be delivered to PROF. OAK from VIRIDIAN CITY’s POKéMON MART.
oaks-parcel.efectoItemEN: A parcel to be delivered to Professor Oak for a Pokédex.

poke-flute.descES: Una flauta con un timbre tan dulce y hermoso que despierta hasta al Pokémon más profundamente dormido.
poke-flute.descEN: A flute that can play with such a beautiful tone that even sleeping Pokémon find themselves woken up.
poke-flute.efectoItemEN: Wakes up sleeping Pokémon. Required to wake up sleeping Snorlax on the overworld.

bike-voucher.descEN: Take this voucher to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY and exchange it for a bicycle.
bike-voucher.efectoItemEN: May be traded for a Bicycle.

gold-teeth.descES: Unos dientes de oro que perdió el Guarda de la Zona Safari con los que tiene una sonrisa deslumbrante.
gold-teeth.descEN: A set of golden false teeth lost by the Safari Zone’s warden. They make his smile sparkle.
gold-teeth.efectoItemEN: The Safari Zone warden’s teeth, to be returned to him for HM04.

lift-key.descES: Llave que permite acceder al ascensor de la Guarida del Team Rocket. Lleva grabado el símbolo del Team Rocket.
lift-key.descEN: A key that operates the elevator in the Team Rocket Hideout. It bears the Team Rocket logo.
lift-key.efectoItemEN: Operates the elevator in the Celadon Rocket Hideout.

silph-scope.descES: Dispositivo que permite ver cosas que, de otra forma, resultarían invisibles para el ojo humano. Fabricado por Silph S. A.
silph-scope.descEN: A scope that lets you see what cannot usually be seen. It is made by Silph Co.

fame-checker.descEN: A device that enables you to recall what you’ve heard and seen about famous people.
fame-checker.efectoItemEN: Records information on various famous people.

tm-case.descEN: A case that holds TMs and HMs. It is attached to the BAG’s compartment for important items.

berry-pouch.descEN: A pouch for carrying BERRIES. It is attached to the BAG’s compartment for important items.

teachy-tv.descEN: A television set that is tuned to a program with useful tips for novice TRAINERS.

tri-pass.descEN: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND. It has a drawing of three islands.
tri-pass.efectoItemEN: Provides access to the first three Sevii Islands.

rainbow-pass.descEN: A pass for ferries between VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS. It features a drawing of a rainbow.
rainbow-pass.efectoItemEN: Provides access to the Sevii Islands.

tea.descES: Un aromático té de sabor ligeramente amargo que resulta ideal para aplacar la sed.
tea.descEN: Aromatic tea that has a slightly bitter taste. It soothes a dry throat.
tea.efectoItemEN: Used to bribe the Saffron City guards for entry to the city.

mysticticket.descEN: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK. It glows with a mystic light.
mysticticket.efectoItemEN: Provides access to Navel Rock, Ho-Oh, and Lugia.

auroraticket.descEN: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND. It glows beautifully.
auroraticket.efectoItemEN: Provides access to Birth Island and Deoxys.

powder-jar.descEN: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.
powder-jar.efectoItemEN: Holds Berry Powder from Berry Crushing.

ruby.descEN: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a red glow. It symbolizes passion.
ruby.efectoItemEN: Deliver to Celio for use in the Network Machine.

sapphire.descEN: An exquisitely beautiful gem that has a blue glow. It symbolizes honesty.
sapphire.efectoItemEN: Deliver to Celio for use in the Network Machine.

magma-emblem.descEN: A medal-like item in the same shape as TEAM MAGMA’s mark.
magma-emblem.efectoItemEN: Provides access to the Magma Hideout in the Jagged Pass.

old-sea-map.descEN: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a certain island.
old-sea-map.efectoItemEN: Provides access to Faraway Island and Mew.

douse-drive.descES: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Agua.
douse-drive.descEN: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Water type.
douse-drive.efectoItemEN: Held by Genesect : Holder’s buster is blue, and its Techno Blast is Water-type.

shock-drive.descES: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Eléctrico.
shock-drive.descEN: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Electric type.
shock-drive.efectoItemEN: Held by Genesect : Holder’s buster is yellow, and its Techno Blast is Electric-type.

burn-drive.descES: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Fuego.
burn-drive.descEN: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Fire type.
burn-drive.efectoItemEN: Held by Genesect : Holder’s buster is red, and its Techno Blast is Fire-type.

chill-drive.descES: Cartucho que convierte Tecno Shock de Genesect en un movimiento de tipo Hielo.
chill-drive.descEN: A cassette to be held by Genesect. It changes Genesect’s Techno Blast move so it becomes Ice type.
chill-drive.efectoItemEN: Held by Genesect : Holder’s buster is white, and its Techno Blast becomes Ice-type.

sweet-heart.descES: Chocolatina de sabor dulce. Restaura 20 PS de un Pokémon.
sweet-heart.descEN: A piece of cloyingly sweet chocolate. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a single Pokémon.
sweet-heart.efectoItemEN: Used on a friendly Pokémon : Restores 20 HP.

greet-mail.descES: Carta para presentarse a alguien. Haz que la entregue un Pokémon.
greet-mail.descEN: Stationery designed to be easy to use when writing someone for the first time. Have a Pokémon hold it for delivery.
greet-mail.efectoItemEN: Used to send short messages to other players via Pokémon trading. Trainer may compose a message from a finite list of words when giving this item to a Pokémon. Once taken and read, a message may be erased and this item can be reused, or the message may be stored in the trainer’s PC. Held : Holder cannot be placed in the PC. Any move attempting to remove this item from the holder will fail.

prism-scale.descES: Curiosa escama que hace evolucionar a cierto Pokémon. Brilla con los colores del arcoíris.
prism-scale.descEN: A mysterious scale that causes a certain Pokémon to evolve. It shines in rainbow colors.
prism-scale.efectoItemEN: Held by Feebas : Holder evolves into Milotic when traded.

eviolite.descES: Roca misteriosa. El Pokémon portador aumentará su Defensa y su Defensa Especial si aún puede evolucionar.
eviolite.descEN: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held by a Pokémon that can still evolve, it raises both Defense and Sp. Def.
eviolite.efectoItemEN: Held by a Pokémon that is not fully evolved : Holder has 1.5× Defense and Special Defense.

float-stone.descES: Piedra muy ligera que reduce el peso del Pokémon que la lleve.
float-stone.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This very light stone reduces the weight of a Pokémon when held.

rocky-helmet.descES: Si el portador es alcanzado por un movimiento de contacto, el agresor también recibe daño.
rocky-helmet.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.
rocky-helmet.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder is hit by a contact move, the attacking Pokémon takes 1/6 its max HP in damage.

air-balloon.descES: El Pokémon que lo lleve flotará en el aire. Si recibe un golpe, estallará.
air-balloon.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will float in the air until hit. Once the holder is hit, this item will burst.
air-balloon.efectoItemEN: Held : Holder is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This effect does not apply during Gravity or Ingrain. When the holder takes damage from a move, this item is consumed.

red-card.descES: Misteriosa tarjeta que permite al Pokémon que la lleva expulsar al oponente cuando este le cause daño.
red-card.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit by an attack, the attacker is removed from battle.
red-card.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder takes damage directly from a move and does not faint, it switches out for another random, non-fainted Pokémon in its party. This effect does not activate if another effect prevents the holder from switching out.

ring-target.descES: El Pokémon que lo lleva es vulnerable frente a movimientos que normalmente no afectan a su tipo.
ring-target.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Moves that normally have no effect will land on a Pokémon holding it.
ring-target.efectoItemEN: Held : When one of the user’s types would render it immune to damage, that type is ignored for damage calculation.

binding-band.descES: Banda que potencia los movimientos que estrujan al rival.
binding-band.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a band that increases the power of binding moves used by the holder.
binding-band.efectoItemEN: Held : Moves used by the holder that trap and damage a target for multiple turns (e.g. Bind, Fire Spin) inflict twice their usual per-turn damage.

absorb-bulb.descES: Aumenta el Ataque Especial del portador si le alcanza un ataque de tipo Agua. Desaparece tras usarlo.
absorb-bulb.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Atk if the holder is hit with a Water-type attack. It can only be used once.
absorb-bulb.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder takes Water-type damage from a move, its Special Attack rises by one stage and this item is consumed.

cell-battery.descES: Batería de usar y tirar que sube el Ataque de quien la lleva cuando recibe un golpe de tipo Eléctrico.
cell-battery.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Attack if the holder is hit with an Electric-type attack. It can only be used once.
cell-battery.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder takes Electric-type damage from a move, its Attack rises by one stage and this item is consumed.

eject-button.descES: Si el portador es alcanzado por un ataque, saldrá del combate y será sustituido por otro Pokémon del equipo.
eject-button.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit by an attack, it will be switched out of battle.
eject-button.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder takes damage directly from a move and does not faint, it switches out for another non-fainted Pokémon in its party, as chosen by the Trainer. This effect does not activate if another effect prevents the holder from switching out.

fire-gem.descES: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
fire-gem.descEN: A gem with an essence of fire. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fire-type move one time.
fire-gem.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder uses a damaging Fire-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.

pretty-wing.descES: Pluma normal y corriente. Muy bonita, pero no sirve para nada.
pretty-wing.descEN: Though this feather is beautiful, it’s just a regular feather and has no effect.

cover-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que vivía en el fondo del mar. Parece ser un fragmento de caparazón.
cover-fossil.descEN: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. It appears as though it could be part of its back.
cover-fossil.efectoItemEN: Give to a scientist in a museum to receive a Tirtouga.

plume-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que surcaba los cielos. Parece ser parte de una de sus alas.
plume-fossil.descEN: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sky. It looks as if it could come from part of its wing.
plume-fossil.efectoItemEN: Give to a scientist in a museum to receive an Archen.

liberty-pass.descES: Ticket especial para ir en barco desde Ciudad Porcelana a Isla Libertad.
liberty-pass.descEN: A special pass to go to Liberty Garden. Board the ship in Castelia City.
liberty-pass.efectoItemEN: Allows passage on the Castelia City ship, which leads to Liberty Garden and Victini.

pass-orb.descES: Esfera misteriosa que contiene el poder de la región de Teselia y se utiliza para generar Poderes Regalo.
pass-orb.descEN: A mysterious orb containing the power of the Unova region, to be used when generating Pass Power.
pass-orb.efectoItemEN: Acts as currency to activate Pass Powers in the Entralink.

dream-ball.descES: Es algo distinta a las demás. Funciona especialmente bien con los Pokémon dormidos.
dream-ball.descEN: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon while they’re asleep.
dream-ball.efectoItemEN: Can only be used in Entree Forest, to catch Pokémon encountered in the Dream World. Used in battle : Catches a wild Pokémon without fail.

poke-toy.descES: Un objeto que atrae a los Pokémon. Es útil para huir de un combate contra un Pokémon salvaje.
poke-toy.descEN: A toy that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.
poke-toy.efectoItemEN: Used in battle : Ends a wild battle. Cannot be used in trainer battles.

prop-case.descES: Una bonita cajita donde guardar todos los Complementos para vestir a tus Pokémon en el Teatro Musical.
prop-case.descEN: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.
prop-case.efectoItemEN: Stores props for the Pokémon Musical.

dragon-skull.descES: Cráneo de un Pokémon. Se dice que este Pokémon cruzó mares embravecidos.
dragon-skull.descEN: A skull of a Pokémon that was said to have braved the angry waters to fly around the world.
dragon-skull.efectoItemEN: Only used as a plot point; this item is given to the player and taken away in the same cutscene.

balm-mushroom.descES: Extraña seta que desprende un agradable aroma. Puede alcanzar un alto precio en las tiendas.
balm-mushroom.descEN: A rare mushroom that gives off a nice fragrance. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

big-nugget.descES: Pepita grande de oro puro que desprende un brillo espectacular. Puede venderse a un precio muy alto en las tiendas.
big-nugget.descEN: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

pearl-string.descES: Brillantes perlas plateadas de gran tamaño que pueden venderse a buen precio en las tiendas.
pearl-string.descEN: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. They can be sold at a high price to shops.

comet-shard.descES: Fragmento de un cometa caído al suelo al atravesar la atmósfera. Se puede vender a buen precio en las tiendas.
comet-shard.descEN: A shard that fell to the ground when a comet approached. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

relic-copper.descES: Moneda de cobre de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-copper.descEN: A copper coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-silver.descES: Moneda de plata de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-silver.descEN: A silver coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-gold.descES: Moneda de oro de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-gold.descEN: A gold coin used by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-vase.descES: Jarrón de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-vase.descEN: A fragile vase made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-band.descES: Brazalete de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-band.descEN: A heavy bracelet made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-statue.descES: Efigie de piedra de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-statue.descEN: A stone figurine made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

relic-crown.descES: Corona de más de 3000 años de antigüedad.
relic-crown.descEN: A heavy crown made by an ancient civilization about three thousand years ago.

casteliacone.descES: Especialidad de Ciudad Porcelana. Cura los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
casteliacone.descEN: Castelia City’s specialty, soft-serve ice cream. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
casteliacone.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures any status ailment and confusion.

dire-hit-2.descES: Aumenta la probabilidad de asestar un golpe crítico. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
dire-hit-2.descEN: It can be used many times to raise the critical-hit ratio of one Pokémon. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
dire-hit-2.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s critical hit rate by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-speed-2.descES: Aumenta ligeramente la Velocidad en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-speed-2.descEN: It sharply raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-speed-2.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Speed by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-sp-atk-2.descES: Aumenta ligeramente el Ataque Especial en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-sp-atk-2.descEN: It sharply raises the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-sp-atk-2.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Special Attack by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-sp-def-2.descES: Aumenta ligeramente la Defensa Especial en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-sp-def-2.descEN: It sharply raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-sp-def-2.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Special Defense by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-defense-2.descEN: It sharply raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-defense-2.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Defense by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-attack-2.descEN: It sharply raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-attack-2.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Attack by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-accuracy-2.descES: Aumenta ligeramente la Precisión en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-accuracy-2.descEN: It sharply raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-accuracy-2.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s accuracy by two stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-speed-3.descEN: It drastically raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-speed-3.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Speed by three stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-speed-6.descEN: It raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
x-speed-6.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Speed by six stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

x-sp-def-6.descEN: It raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.

x-accuracy-6.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s accuracy by six stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

ability-urge.descES: Al usarlo, activa la habilidad de un Pokémon de tu equipo.
ability-urge.descEN: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pokémon.
ability-urge.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokémon at random. If that Pokémon’s ability is normally activated by some condition—i.e., is not continuous and passive—its effect is forcibly activated. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

item-drop.descES: Cuando se usa, un Pokémon de tu equipo pierde su objeto.
item-drop.descEN: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to drop a held item.
item-drop.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokémon at random. If that Pokémon is holding an item, that item is removed for the duration of the battle. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

item-urge.descES: Cuando se usa, un Pokémon de tu equipo utiliza su objeto inmediatamente.
item-urge.descEN: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to use its held item.
item-urge.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokémon at random. If that Pokémon is holding an item normally activated by some condition—i.e., not continuous and passive—its effect is forcibly activated. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

reset-urge.descES: Cuando se usa, se anulan los cambios en las características de un Pokémon de tu equipo.
reset-urge.descEN: When used, it restores any stat changes of an ally Pokémon.
reset-urge.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Selects another friendly Pokémon at random. Removes all of that Pokémon’s stat changes. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

dire-hit-3.descES: Aumenta mucho la probabilidad de asestar un golpe crítico. Al cambiar de Pokémon, su efecto desaparece.
dire-hit-3.descEN: It can be used many times to greatly raise a Pokémon’s critical-hit ratio. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
dire-hit-3.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s critical hit rate by three stages. This item can only be obtained or used via the Wonder Launcher.

light-stone.descES: Forma que adoptó Reshiram al perder su cuerpo. Espera la llegada de un nuevo héroe.
light-stone.descEN: Reshiram’s body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.
light-stone.efectoItemEN: Summons Reshiram for the final battle against N.

dark-stone.descES: Forma que adoptó Zekrom al perder su cuerpo. Espera la llegada de un nuevo héroe.
dark-stone.descEN: Zekrom’s body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.
dark-stone.efectoItemEN: Summons Zekrom for the final battle against N.

tm93.descES: El usuario irradia unas raras ondas que, al alcanzar a un oponente, hacen que disminuya mucho su Ataque Especial.
tm93.descEN: The user’s body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
tm93.efectoItemEN: Teaches Wild Charge to a compatible Pokémon.

tm94.descES: Ataque moderado que no debilita al objetivo y le deja al menos 1 PS.
tm94.descEN: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
tm94.efectoItemEN: Teaches Rock Smash to a compatible Pokémon.

tm95.descES: Ataca con un viento afilado que incluso corta el aire. También puede amedrentar al objetivo.
tm95.descEN: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
tm95.efectoItemEN: Teaches Snarl to a compatible Pokémon.

xtransceiver.descES: Comunicador de alta tecnología con cámara que permite hablar a cuatro personas a la vez.
xtransceiver.descEN: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.
xtransceiver.efectoItemEN: Makes four-way video calls. Used for plot advancement in-game, but also works with other players via the C-Gear.

god-stone.descES: Este aparato permite recibir vídeos holográficos y visualizarlos en cualquier momento.

gram-1.descEN: An important letter that Wingull delivers.
gram-1.efectoItemEN: Give to the Wingull on Route 13, along with Gram 2 and Gram 3, to receive TM89.

gram-2.descEN: An important letter that Wingull delivers.
gram-2.efectoItemEN: Give to the Wingull on Route 13, along with Gram 1 and Gram 3, to receive TM89.

gram-3.descEN: An important letter that Wingull delivers.
gram-3.efectoItemEN: Give to the Wingull on Route 13, along with Gram 1 and Gram 2, to receive TM89.

dragon-gem.descES: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
dragon-gem.descEN: A gem with a draconic essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Dragon-type move one time.
dragon-gem.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder uses a damaging Dragon-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.

normal-gem.descES: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Normal. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
normal-gem.descEN: A gem with an ordinary essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Normal-type move one time.
normal-gem.efectoItemEN: Held : When the holder uses a damaging Normal-type move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.

medal-box.descES: Un dispositivo con forma de caja que almacena las insignias y la información relacionada.
medal-box.descEN: A box-shaped machine that stores Medals and Medal information.
medal-box.efectoItemEN: Holds medals recieved in the medal rally.

dna-splicers.descES: Punta que permite fusionar a Kyurem con cierto Pokémon con el que, originariamente, formaba un solo ser.
dna-splicers.descEN: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.
dna-splicers.efectoItemEN: Fuses Kyurem with Reshiram or Zekrom, or splits them apart again.

permit.descES: Permiso necesario para acceder a la Reserva Natural, lugar que solo unos pocos conocen.
permit.descEN: A permit that is needed to enter the Nature Preserve. Not many know about it.
permit.efectoItemEN: Grants access to the Nature Preserve.

oval-charm.descES: Misterioso amuleto ovalado que aumenta la posibilidad de encontrar Huevos en Cuidados Pokémon.
oval-charm.descEN: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Pokémon Eggs being found at the Nursery.
oval-charm.efectoItemEN: Doubles the chance of two Pokémon producing an egg at the daycare every 255 steps.

shiny-charm.descES: Misterioso amuleto brillante que aumenta la probabilidad de encontrar Pokémon variocolor.
shiny-charm.descEN: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pokémon in the wild.
shiny-charm.efectoItemEN: Raises the chance of finding a shiny Pokémon.

plasma-card.descES: Tarjeta necesaria para introducir la contraseña en la Fragata Plasma.
plasma-card.descEN: A card key needed to enter the password inside the Plasma Frigate.
plasma-card.efectoItemEN: Required to progress in the Plasma Frigate.

grubby-hanky.descES: Pañuelo perdido por un cliente habitual del Café Alma en Ciudad Esmalte. Desprende el olor de un Pokémon.
grubby-hanky.descEN: A handkerchief dropped by a regular at Café Warehouse. It smells faintly like a Pokémon.
grubby-hanky.efectoItemEN: Appears in the Café Warehouse on Sunday; return to the customer with a Patrat on Thursday.

colress-machine.descES: Dispositivo que permite aumentar forzadamente las características de los Pokémon. Es un prototipo imperfecto.
colress-machine.descEN: A special device that wrings out the potential of Pokémon. It’s an imperfect prototype.
colress-machine.efectoItemEN: Wakes up the Crustle blocking the way in Seaside Cave.

dropped-item.descES: Videomisor encontrado en el parque de atracciones de Ciudad Mayólica. Parece que pertenece a un chico.
dropped-item.descEN: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a boy.
dropped-item.efectoItemEN: Returned to Curtis or Yancy as part of a sidequest.

reveal-glass.descES: Espejo misterioso que refleja la verdad y devuelve los Pokémon a su forma original.
reveal-glass.descEN: A looking glass that reveals the truth. It’s a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon to its original shape.
reveal-glass.efectoItemEN: Switches Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus between Incarnate and Therian Forme.

weakness-policy.descES: Aumenta mucho el Ataque y el Ataque Especial cuando el Pokémon que lo lleva recibe un ataque frente al cual es débil.
weakness-policy.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Attack and Sp. Atk sharply increase if the holder is hit with a move it’s weak to.
weakness-policy.efectoItemEN: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.

assault-vest.descES: Chaleco que potencia la Defensa Especial del Pokémon que lo lleva, pero le impide lanzar movimientos de estado.
assault-vest.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This offensive vest raises Sp. Def but prevents the use of status moves.
assault-vest.efectoItemEN: Raises the holder’s Special Defense to 1.5×. Prevents the holder from selecting a status move.

pixie-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Hada. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
pixie-plate.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fairy-type moves.
pixie-plate.efectoItemEN: Held: Fairy-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Fairy.

ability-capsule.descES: Cápsula que les permite cambiar de habilidad a los Pokémon que poseen dos.
ability-capsule.descEN: A capsule that allows a Pokémon with two Abilities to switch between these Abilities when it is used.
ability-capsule.efectoItemEN: Switches a Pokémon between its two possible (non-Hidden) Abilities.

whipped-dream.descES: Un dulce a base de suave y esponjosa nata montada. A cierto Pokémon le encanta.
whipped-dream.descEN: A soft and sweet treat made of fluffy, puffy, whipped, and whirled cream. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.
whipped-dream.efectoItemEN: Traded on a Swirlix: Holder evolves into Slurpuff.

sachet.descES: Un saquito lleno de sustancias aromáticas cuyo perfume resulta abrumador, pero que a cierto Pokémon le encanta.
sachet.descEN: A sachet filled with fragrant perfumes that are just slightly too overwhelming. Yet it’s loved by a certain Pokémon.
sachet.efectoItemEN: Traded on a Spritzee: Holder evolves into Aromatisse.

luminous-moss.descES: Objeto de un solo uso. Aumenta la Defensa Especial del Pokémon que lo lleva si este recibe un ataque de tipo Agua.
luminous-moss.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Def if the holder is hit with a Water-type attack. It can only be used once.
luminous-moss.efectoItemEN: Held: If the holder is hit by a damaging Water move, it consumes this item and raises its Special Defense by one stage.

snowball.descES: Objeto de un solo uso. Aumenta el Ataque del Pokémon que lo lleva si este recibe un ataque de tipo Hielo.
snowball.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Attack if the holder is hit with an Ice-type attack. It can only be used once.
snowball.efectoItemEN: Held: If the holder is hit by a damaging Ice move, raises its Attack by one stage.

safety-goggles.descES: Gafa que protege de los efectos adversos del clima y del polvo lanzado por los rivales.
safety-goggles.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These goggles protect the holder from both weather-related damage and powder.
safety-goggles.efectoItemEN: Held: Prevents damage from powder moves and the damage from Hail and Sandstorm.

rich-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
rich-mulch.descEN: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
rich-mulch.efectoItemEN: Increases the total number of Berries by 2.

surprise-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
surprise-mulch.descEN: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
surprise-mulch.efectoItemEN: Increases the chance of Berry mutation.

boost-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
boost-mulch.descEN: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
boost-mulch.efectoItemEN: Causes soil to dry out in 4 hours.

amaze-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
amaze-mulch.descEN: A fertilizer for growing Berries. However, it appears to be unsuitable for the soil in the Hoenn region and has no effect.
amaze-mulch.efectoItemEN: Increases the total number of Berries by 2, increases the chance of Berry mutation, and causes soil to dry out in 4 hours.

gengarite.descES: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Permite megaevolucionar a Gengar en combate.
gengarite.descEN: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Gengar hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
gengarite.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Gengar to Mega Evolve into Mega Gengar.

gardevoirite.descES: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Permite megaevolucionar a Gardevoir en combate.
gardevoirite.descEN: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Gardevoir hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
gardevoirite.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Gardevoir to Mega Evolve into Mega Gardevoir.

roseli-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, debilita un ataque supereficaz de tipo Hada de un enemigo.
roseli-berry.descEN: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will lessen the damage taken from one supereffective Fairy-type attack.
roseli-berry.efectoItemEN: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Fairy-type attack to halve the damage.

kee-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, aumenta su Defensa tras recibir un ataque físico.
kee-berry.descEN: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will increase the holder’s Defense if it’s hit with a physical move.
kee-berry.efectoItemEN: Held: When the holder is hit by a physical move, increases its Defense by one stage.

maranga-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, aumenta su Defensa Especial tras recibir un ataque especial.
maranga-berry.descEN: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will increase the holder’s Sp. Def if it’s hit with a special move.
maranga-berry.efectoItemEN: Held: When the holder is hit by a special move, increases its Special Defense by one stage.

discount-coupon.descES: Con este vale te harán jugosos descuentos cuando vayas de compras a una boutique.
discount-coupon.descEN: This special coupon allows you to buy items at a discount when you are shopping at a boutique.
discount-coupon.efectoItemEN: Can be used at a boutique for a 50% discount. Consumed once used.

strange-souvenir.descES: Ornamento que representa a un Pokémon misterioso venerado desde la antigüedad en Alola como espíritu protector.
strange-souvenir.descEN: An ornament depicting a mysterious Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity for an extremely long time in the Alola region.

lumiose-galette.descES: El dulce estrella de Ciudad Luminalia. Cura los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
lumiose-galette.descEN: A popular treat in Lumiose City. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
lumiose-galette.efectoItemEN: Cures all major status ailments and confusion.

jaw-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico terrestre. Parece ser parte de una mandíbula.
jaw-fossil.descEN: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks as if it could be a piece of a large jaw.
jaw-fossil.efectoItemEN: Can be revived into a Tyrunt.

sail-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico terrestre. Parece la impresión de una aleta.
sail-fossil.descEN: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks like the impression from a skin sail.
sail-fossil.efectoItemEN: Can be revived into an Amaura.

fairy-gem.descES: Joya de un solo uso que potencia los movimientos de tipo Hada. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
fairy-gem.descEN: A gem with an essence of the fey. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fairy-type move one time.
fairy-gem.efectoItemEN: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Fairy move, the move has 1.5× power and this item is consumed.

adventure-rules.descES: Pequeño dispositivo que va añadiendo y compilando de forma automática consejos y pistas útiles para la aventura de todo Entrenador.
adventure-rules.descEN: A compact device that automatically collects and records advice when a Trainer is out on an adventure.

elevator-key.descES: Tarjeta con el logotipo del Team Flare que activa el ascensor de los Laboratorios Lysson.
elevator-key.descEN: A card key that activates the elevator in Lysandre Labs. It is emblazoned with Team Flare’s logo.
elevator-key.efectoItemEN: Unlocks the elevator in Lysandre Labs.

holo-caster.descES: Este aparato permite recibir vídeos holográficos y visualizarlos en cualquier momento.
holo-caster.descEN: A device that allows users to receive and view hologram clips at any time. It’s also used to chat with others.
holo-caster.efectoItemEN: Displays cutscene conversations as the plot advances.

honor-of-kalos.descES: Símbolo otorgado en reconocimiento a quienes han realizado gestas excepcionales en la región de Kalos.
honor-of-kalos.descEN: A precious symbol that is awarded only to an individual who has done great things for the Kalos region.
honor-of-kalos.efectoItemEN: Does nothing, but signifies becoming Champion.

intriguing-stone.descES: Una curiosa piedra que a algunos les puede parecer de gran valor.
intriguing-stone.descEN: A rather curious stone that might appear valuable to some. It’s all in the eye of the beholder.
intriguing-stone.efectoItemEN: Trade for a Sun Stone in X and Y, or Pidgeotite in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire.

lens-case.descES: Estuche de aspecto sofisticado para llevar tus lentes de contacto.
lens-case.descEN: A rather chic-looking case for carrying contact lenses.
lens-case.efectoItemEN: Allows the player to change their eye color.

looker-ticket.descES: Boleto hecho a mano por Handsome, decorado con una generosa cantidad de purpurina.
looker-ticket.descEN: A ticket that was handmade by Looker. It’s decorated with a liberal amount of glittery paint.

mega-ring.descES: Accesorio con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-ring.descEN: This ring contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve in battle.
mega-ring.efectoItemEN: Allows the player’s Pokémon to Mega Evolve.

power-plant-pass.descES: Documento de identificación necesario para acceder a la central eléctrica de la Ruta 13.
power-plant-pass.descEN: This pass serves as an ID card for gaining access to the Power Plant that lies along Route 13.
power-plant-pass.efectoItemEN: Permits entry to the Kalos Power Plant.

profs-letter.descES: Una carta sutilmente perfumada que el Profesor Ciprés le ha escrito a tu madre.
profs-letter.descEN: A letter that Professor Sycamore wrote to your mother. A faint but pleasant perfume seems to cling to the paper.
profs-letter.efectoItemEN: Traded to the player’s mom for the Town Map and a Potion.

roller-skates.descES: Ruedas que se acoplan a la suela del calzado y te permiten ir más rápido y realizar piruetas espectaculares.
roller-skates.descEN: Attaches roller skates to the bottom of your shoes, allowing you to glide quickly around and perform tricks.
roller-skates.efectoItemEN: Allows the player to move quickly and off the grid.

sprinklotad.descES: Una regadera con forma de Lotad. Ayuda a que las bayas plantadas en suelo blandito crezcan mejor.
sprinklotad.descEN: A watering can shaped like a Lotad. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

tmv-pass.descES: Pase que permite realizar viajes ilimitados en el TMV que une las ciudades de Luminalia y Batik.
tmv-pass.descEN: A commuter pass that allows the holder to ride the TMV between Lumiose City and Kiloude City at any time.

tm96.descES: El usuario ensarta al adversario con su afilada cornamenta. Este movimiento acierta siempre.
tm96.descEN: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

tm97.descES: Hace pivotar su cuerpo para causar daño a su alrededor.
tm97.descEN: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

tm98.descES: Usa la frustración como revulsivo para atacar. La potencia de Pataleta se duplica si el usuario ha fallado el último movimiento usado.
tm98.descEN: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

tm99.descES: El usuario sacude violentamente su enorme cola para golpear a todos los rivales y reducir su Ataque a la par.
tm99.descEN: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

tm100.descES: Hace que el objetivo pierda la concentración contándole un secreto. Disminuye el Ataque Especial del oponente.
tm100.descEN: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

latiasite.descES: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Permite megaevolucionar a Latias en combate.
latiasite.descEN: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Latias hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
latiasite.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Latias to Mega Evolve into Mega Latias.

latiosite.descES: Una de las misteriosas Megapiedras. Permite megaevolucionar a Latios en combate.
latiosite.descEN: One of a variety of mysterious Mega Stones. Have Latios hold it, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
latiosite.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Latios to Mega Evolve into Mega Latios.

common-stone.descES: Una piedra de aspecto normal que a algunos les puede parecer de gran valor.
common-stone.descEN: A perfectly normal stone that might appear to be valuable to some. It’s all in the eye of the beholder.

makeup-bag.descES: Neceser de aspecto sofisticado para guardar tus barras de labios.
makeup-bag.descEN: A rather chic-looking case for carrying lipsticks.
makeup-bag.efectoItemEN: Allows the player to change their lipstick color.

travel-trunk.descES: Maleta ligera de increíble capacidad donde podrás guardar todas las prendas de ropa que quieras.
travel-trunk.descEN: A light and yet incredibly effective trunk, which can contain every last piece of clothing that can be bought.
travel-trunk.efectoItemEN: Unobtainable, but allows the player to change clothes anywhere.

shalour-sable.descES: Especialidad de Ciudad Yantra. Cura los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
shalour-sable.descEN: Shalour City’s famous shortbread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
shalour-sable.efectoItemEN: Cures any major status ailment and confusion.

mega-charm.descES: Amuleto con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-charm.descEN: This charm contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve in battle.
mega-charm.efectoItemEN: Unused. This appears as the girlplayer’s Mega Bracelet in Pokémon Contests, but it cannot actually be obtained.

mega-glove.descES: Guante con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-glove.descEN: This glove contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying Mega Stones to Mega Evolve in battle.
mega-glove.efectoItemEN: Unused. This is Korrina’s Key Stone in X and Y, but it cannot be obtained by the player.

devon-parts.descES: Contiene piezas de algo fabricado por Devon S. A.
devon-parts.descEN: A case that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the Devon Corporation.
devon-parts.efectoItemEN: Allows Captain Stern to set out on his expedition.

pokeblock-kit.descES: Kit consistente en una Licuabayas para preparar Pokécubos a partir de bayas y un Tubo Pokécubos para guardarlos.
pokeblock-kit.descEN: A set containing a Berry Blender for making Pokéblocks and a Pokéblock Case for storing Pokéblocks.

key-to-room-1.descES: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-1.descEN: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-1.efectoItemEN: Unlocks the door to Room 1 in Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-2.descES: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-2.descEN: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-2.efectoItemEN: Unlocks the door to Room 2 in Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-4.descES: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-4.descEN: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-4.efectoItemEN: Unlocks the door to Room 4 in Sea Mauville.

key-to-room-6.descES: Llave de acceso a una de las habitaciones de Malvamar.
key-to-room-6.descEN: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.
key-to-room-6.efectoItemEN: Unlocks the door to Room 6 in Sea Mauville.

devon-scuba-gear.descES: Máscara que surte de oxígeno durante las inmersiones en el agua. Producto de Devon S. A.
devon-scuba-gear.descEN: A device made by Devon Corporation that provides oxygen to users during the use of Dive.
devon-scuba-gear.efectoItemEN: Worn by the player while underwater via Dive in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire.

contest-costume--jacket.descES: Traje de lo más espectacular para lucir en el Gran Concurso.
contest-costume--jacket.descEN: A very cool suit to be worn during the Contest Spectacular.

magma-suit.descES: Este traje es el resultado de las arduas investigaciones científicas del Equipo Magma. Es capaz de soportar cualquier impacto.
magma-suit.descEN: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Magma. It can withstand any impact.
magma-suit.efectoItemEN: Allows the player to ride Groudon in the Cave of Origin.

aqua-suit.descES: Este traje es el resultado de las arduas investigaciones científicas del Equipo Aqua. Es capaz de soportar cualquier impacto.
aqua-suit.descEN: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Aqua. It can withstand any impact.
aqua-suit.efectoItemEN: Allows the player to ride Kyogre in the Cave of Origin.

pair-of-tickets.descES: Pase de dos personas para asistir al espectáculo de astronomía que se celebra en el Centro Espacial de Algaria.
pair-of-tickets.descEN: Tickets for two to the astronomical show being held at the Mossdeep Space Center.
pair-of-tickets.efectoItemEN: Allows the player and their mother to see the star show in the Mossdeep Space Center.

mega-bracelet.descES: Aro con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-bracelet.descEN: This cuff contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.
mega-bracelet.efectoItemEN: Allows the player’s Pokémon to Mega Evolve.

mega-pendant.efectoItemEN: Unused. This is Wally’s Key Stone in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, but it cannot be obtained by the player.

mega-glasses.efectoItemEN: Unused. This is Maxie’s Key Stone in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, but it cannot be obtained by the player.

mega-anchor.efectoItemEN: Unused. This is Archie’s Key Stone in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, but it cannot be obtained by the player.

mega-anklet.efectoItemEN: Unused. This is Zinnia’s Key Stone in Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, but it cannot be obtained by the player.

prison-bottle.descEN: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.
prison-bottle.efectoItemEN: Transforms Hoopa into its Unbound form for up to three days.

mega-cuff.descES: Brazalete con un poder misterioso que permite megaevolucionar a Pokémon que lleven la Megapiedra adecuada.
mega-cuff.descEN: This bracelet contains an untold power that somehow enables Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.
mega-cuff.efectoItemEN: Unused. This appears as the boy player’s Mega Bracelet in Pokémon Contests, but it cannot actually be obtained.

key-stone.descES: Piedra de singulares poderes que permite megaevolucionar en combate a un Pokémon que lleve consigo una Megapiedra.
key-stone.descEN: A stone filled with an unexplained power. It makes Pokémon that battle with a Mega Stone Mega Evolve.
key-stone.efectoItemEN: Allows the player’s Pokémon to Mega Evolve.

meteorite-shard.descES: Trozo de meteorito encontrado en el suelo de la Cueva Granito. Es ligeramente cálido al tacto.
meteorite-shard.descEN: One of the fragments of a Meteorite from Granite Cave. It’s faintly warm to the touch.
meteorite-shard.efectoItemEN: Causes the Meteorite to transform to its final form, allowing Rayquaza to Mega Evolve.

eon-flute.descES: Flauta capaz de invocar a Latios o Latias en cualquier lugar.
eon-flute.descEN: A flute that can be used to summon Latios or Latias no matter where you are.
eon-flute.efectoItemEN: Summons Latias or Latios for a ride.

normalium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z a los movimientos de tipo Normal.
normalium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Normal-type moves to Z-Moves.
normalium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows a Pokémon to use the Z-move equivalents of its Normal moves.

fairium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows a Pokémon to use the Z-move equivalents of its Fairy moves.

pikanium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Placaje Eléctrico de Pikachu.
pikanium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Pikachu’s Volt Tackle to a Z-Move.
pikanium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Pikachu to upgrade Volt Tackle into Catastropika.

bottle-cap.descES: Una bonita chapa de color plata. Hay gente que las aprecia mucho.
bottle-cap.descEN: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a silver gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.
bottle-cap.efectoItemEN: Trade to Mr. Hyper to set one of a Pokémon’s genes to 31.

gold-bottle-cap.descES: Una bonita chapa de color dorado, menos común que su equivalente plateada. Hay gente que las aprecia mucho.
gold-bottle-cap.descEN: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a golden gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.
gold-bottle-cap.efectoItemEN: Trade to Mr. Hyper to set all of a Pokémon’s genes to 31.

z-ring.descES: Misteriosa pulsera que transmite la fuerza física y mental del Entrenador a sus Pokémon, lo que les permite usar movimientos Z.
z-ring.descEN: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.
z-ring.efectoItemEN: Allows the player’s Pokémon to use Z-moves.

decidium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Puntada Sombría de Decidueye.
decidium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Decidueye’s Spirit Shackle to a Z-Move.
decidium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Decidueye to upgrade Spirit Shackle into Sinister Arrow Raid.

incinium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Lariat Oscuro de Incineroar.
incinium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Incineroar’s Darkest Lariat to a Z-Move.
incinium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Incineroar to upgrade Darkest Lariat into Malicious Moonsault.

primarium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Aria Burbuja de Primarina.
primarium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Primarina’s Sparkling Aria to a Z-Move.
primarium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Primarina to upgrade Sparkling Aria into Oceanic Operetta.

tapunium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Furia Natural de los Tapu.
tapunium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades the tapu’s Nature’s Madness to a Z-Move.
tapunium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Tapu Koko, Tapu Lele, Tapu Bulu, and Tapu Fini to upgrade Nature’s Madness into Guardian of Alola.

marshadium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Robasombra de Marshadow.
marshadium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Marshadow’s Spectral Thief to a Z-Move.
marshadium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Marshadow to upgrade Spectral Thief into Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike.

aloraichium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Rayo de los Raichu de Alola.
aloraichium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Alolan Raichu’s Thunderbolt to a Z-Move.
aloraichium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Alola Raichu to upgrade Thunderbolt into Stoked Sparksurfer.

snorlium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Gigaimpacto de Snorlax.
snorlium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Snorlax’s Giga Impact to a Z-Move.
snorlium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Snorlax to upgrade Giga Impact into Pulverizing Pancake.

eevium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Última Baza de Eevee.
eevium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Eevee’s Last Resort to a Z-Move.
eevium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Eevee to upgrade Last Resort into Extreme Evoboost.

mewnium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Psíquico de Mew.
mewnium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Mew’s Psychic to a Z-Move.
mewnium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows Mew to upgrade Psychic into Genesis Supernova.

pikashunium-z--held.descES: Cristal que confiere el Poder Z al movimiento Rayo de los Pikachu que llevan gorra.
pikashunium-z--held.descEN: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades a Thunderbolt by Pikachu in a cap to a Z-Move.
pikashunium-z--held.efectoItemEN: Held: Allows cap-wearing Pikachu to upgrade Thunderbolt into 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt.

forage-bag.descES: Saco para guardar ingredientes, indispensable en la Jungla Umbría para superar la prueba de Lulú.
forage-bag.descEN: A bag to carry ingredients gathered during Mallow’s trial in the jungle.

fishing-rod.descES: Caña fabricada por la Capitana Nereida. Permite pescar los Pokémon escondidos en las rocas sumergidas.
fishing-rod.descEN: A fishing rod made by Captain Lana. Cast a line over piles of underwater rocks to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
fishing-rod.efectoItemEN: Allows the player to fish for Pokémon.

professors-mask.descES: La máscara de luchador de Royale, el Enmascarado. Muy probablemente de factura propia.
professors-mask.descEN: The mask that belongs to The Masked Royal. This pro wrestler apparently sews his mask on a machine himself.

festival-ticket.descES: Se puede canjear para organizar minijuegos en la Festi Plaza.
festival-ticket.descEN: A ticket that allows you to host a mission in Festival Plaza.
festival-ticket.efectoItemEN: Hosts a mission in Festival Plaza.

sparkling-stone.descES: Piedra con un misterioso brillo entregada por un Pokémon considerado como uno de los espíritus guardianes de Alola.
sparkling-stone.descEN: A stone entrusted by a Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity in the Alola region. There is said to be some secret in how it sparkles.

adrenaline-orb.descES: Aumenta la Velocidad del portador si se siente intimidado.
adrenaline-orb.descEN: If held by a Pokémon, it boosts Speed when intimidated.
adrenaline-orb.efectoItemEN: Makes wild Pokémon more likely to summon allies. Held: increases the holder’s Speed by one stage when affected by Intimidate.

zygarde-cube.descES: Dispositivo en el que se hallan almacenados núcleos y células de Zygarde. También le permite cambiar de forma.
zygarde-cube.descEN: An item in which Zygarde Cores and Cells are gathered. You can also use it to change Zygarde’s forms.
zygarde-cube.efectoItemEN: Contains collected Zygarde cells/cores. Can teach Zygarde moves.

ice-stone.descES: Una piedra peculiar que hace evolucionar a algunos Pokémon. Presenta motivos que recuerdan a los cristales de hielo.
ice-stone.descEN: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable snowflake pattern.
ice-stone.efectoItemEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves an Alola Sandshrew into Alola Sandslash or an Alola Vulpix into Alola Ninetales.

ride-pager.descES: Dispositivo dotado de un teclado numérico con el que llamar a diversas Pokémonturas.
ride-pager.descEN: By entering certain numbers on this pager, you can summon Ride Pokémon in an instant.
ride-pager.efectoItemEN: Allows the player to summon a Ride Pokémon. Unused, as this can be done simply by pressing Y.

beast-ball.descES: Un tipo especial de Poké Ball con la que resulta difícil atrapar Pokémon.
beast-ball.descEN: A somewhat different Poké Ball that has a low success rate for catching a Pokémon.
beast-ball.efectoItemEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon is an Ultra Beast, this ball has a catch rate of 5×. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 0.1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

big-malasada.descES: Fritura típica de Alola que cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
big-malasada.descEN: The Alola region’s local specialty—fried bread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
big-malasada.efectoItemEN: Cures major status ailments and confusion.

red-nectar.descES: Néctar de ciertas flores de los Jardines de Ula-Ula, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
red-nectar.descEN: A flower nectar obtained at Ula’ula Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
red-nectar.efectoItemEN: Changes Oricorio to Baile Style. Single-use and cannot be used in battle.

yellow-nectar.descES: Néctar de ciertas flores de los Jardines de Melemele, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
yellow-nectar.descEN: A flower nectar obtained at Melemele Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
yellow-nectar.efectoItemEN: Changes Oricorio to Pom-Pom Style. Single-use and cannot be used in battle.

pink-nectar.descES: Néctar de ciertas flores de los parterres de la Avenida Royale, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
pink-nectar.descEN: A flower nectar obtained from the flowering shrubs on Royal Avenue. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
pink-nectar.efectoItemEN: Changes Oricorio to Pa’u Style. Single-use and cannot be used in battle.

purple-nectar.descES: Néctar de ciertas flores de los Jardines de Poni, capaz de hacer cambiar de forma a una determinada especie de Pokémon.
purple-nectar.descEN: A flower nectar obtained at Poni Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
purple-nectar.efectoItemEN: Changes Oricorio to Sensu Style. Single-use and cannot be used in battle.

sun-flute.descES: Flauta que se hace sonar como muestra de gratitud hacia el Pokémon legendario del sol.
sun-flute.descEN: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the sun.
sun-flute.efectoItemEN: Evolves Nebby into Solgaleo when used at the Altar of the Sunne.

moon-flute.descES: Flauta que se hace sonar como muestra de gratitud hacia el Pokémon legendario de la luna.
moon-flute.descEN: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the moon.
moon-flute.efectoItemEN: Evolves Nebby into Lunala when used at the Altar of the Moone.

enigmatic-card.descES: Misteriosa nota que reza: "Te espero en una habitación del motel de la Ruta 8 en Akala".
enigmatic-card.descEN: A mysterious card. Written on it is a request for you to go to a guest room in an Akala motel on Route 8.
enigmatic-card.efectoItemEN: Unlocks Looker’s motel room on Route 8.

terrain-extender.descES: Al llevarlo, prolonga la duración de los campos creados por el Pokémon en el terreno de combate mediante movimientos o su habilidad.
terrain-extender.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the terrain caused by the holder’s move or Ability.
terrain-extender.efectoItemEN: Held: When the holder changes the Terrain (whether by move or ability), it will last 8 turns instead of 5.

protective-pads.descES: Protege al Pokémon de los efectos que le produciría el contacto directo en combate.
protective-pads.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These pads protect the holder from effects caused by making direct contact with the target.
protective-pads.efectoItemEN: Held: Prevents side effects of contact moves used on the holder.

electric-seed.descES: Aumenta la Defensa del portador si se usa cuando el terreno está cubierto por un campo eléctrico.
electric-seed.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Defense on Electric Terrain. It can only be used once.
electric-seed.efectoItemEN: Held: If the holder enters battle during Electric Terrain, or if Electric Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder’s Defense raises by one stage.

psychic-seed.descES: Aumenta la Defensa Especial del portador si se usa cuando el terreno está cubierto por un campo psíquico.
psychic-seed.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Def on Psychic Terrain. It can only be used once.
psychic-seed.efectoItemEN: Held: If the holder enters battle during Psychic Terrain, or if Psychic Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder’s Special Defense raises by one stage.

misty-seed.descES: Aumenta la Defensa Especial del portador si se usa cuando el terreno está cubierto por un campo de niebla.
misty-seed.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Def on Misty Terrain. It can only be used once.
misty-seed.efectoItemEN: Held: If the holder enters battle during Misty Terrain, or if Misty Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder’s Special Defense raises by one stage.

grassy-seed.descES: Aumenta la Defensa del portador si se usa cuando el terreno está cubierto por un campo de hierba.
grassy-seed.descEN: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Defense on Grassy Terrain. It can only be used once.
grassy-seed.efectoItemEN: Held: If the holder enters battle during Grassy Terrain, or if Grassy Terrain is activated while the holder is in battle, this item is consumed and the holder’s Defense raises by one stage.

bike--green.descES: Bicicleta plegable con la que se va más rápido que corriendo.
bike--green.descEN: A folding bike that enables a rider to get around much faster than with Running Shoes.

storage-key--galactic-warehouse.descES: Llave del siniestro almacén del Equipo Galaxia que está ubicado en las afueras de Ciudad Rocavelo.
storage-key--galactic-warehouse.descEN: The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

basement-key--goldenrod.descES: Llave que abre la puerta que hay en el Túnel Trigal.
basement-key--goldenrod.descEN: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.

xtransceiver--red.descES: Comunicador de alta tecnología con cámara que permite hablar a cuatro personas a la vez.
xtransceiver--red.descEN: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.

xtransceiver--yellow.descES: Comunicador de alta tecnología con cámara que permite hablar a cuatro personas a la vez.
xtransceiver--yellow.descEN: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.

dna-splicers--merge.descES: Punta que permite fusionar a Kyurem con cierto Pokémon con el que, originariamente, formaba un solo ser.
dna-splicers--merge.descEN: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.

dna-splicers--split.descES: Punta que permite separar a Kyurem del Pokémon con el que se ha fusionado.
dna-splicers--split.descEN: A splicer that separates Kyurem and a certain Pokémon when they have been fused.

dropped-item--red.descES: Videomisor encontrado en el parque de atracciones de Ciudad Mayólica. Parece que pertenece a un chico.
dropped-item--red.descEN: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a boy.

dropped-item--yellow.descES: Videomisor encontrado en el parque de atracciones de Ciudad Mayólica. Parece que pertenece a una chica.
dropped-item--yellow.descEN: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a girl.

holo-caster--green.descES: Este aparato permite recibir vídeos holográficos y visualizarlos en cualquier momento.
holo-caster--green.descEN: A device that allows users to receive and view hologram clips at any time. It’s also used to chat with others.

bike--yellow.descES: Bicicleta plegable con la que se va más rápido que corriendo.
bike--yellow.descEN: A folding bike that enables a rider to get around much faster than with Running Shoes.

basement-key--new-mauville.descES: Llave que da acceso a Malvalanova, situada en los subterráneos de Ciudad Malvalona.
basement-key--new-mauville.descEN: The key to New Mauville, which was constructed beneath Mauville City.

storage-key--sea-mauville.descES: Llave de acceso al almacén de Malvamar.
storage-key--sea-mauville.descEN: A key that opens the storage hold inside Sea Mauville.

ss-ticket--hoenn.descES: Necesario para montar en barcos de línea regular.
ss-ticket--hoenn.descEN: Ticket required for sailing on a ferry.

contest-costume--dress.descES: Vestido de lo más espectacular para lucir en el Gran Concurso.
contest-costume--dress.descEN: A very cute dress to be worn during the Contest Spectacular.

meteorite--2.descES: Meteorito obtenido en el Monte Cenizo. Desprende un tenue brillo.
meteorite--2.descEN: A Meteorite that you got at Mt. Chimney. It gives off a faint glow.

meteorite--3.descES: Meteorito obtenido en el Monte Cenizo. Sigue desprendiendo un tenue brillo y es ligeramente cálido al tacto.
meteorite--3.descEN: A Meteorite that you got at Mt. Chimney. It continues to give off a faint glow and is slightly warm to the touch.

meteorite--4.descES: Meteorito obtenido en el Monte Cenizo. Presenta unos peculiares grabados e irradia una luz con los siete colores del arcoíris.
meteorite--4.descEN: A Meteorite that you got at Mt. Chimney. Some sort of pattern has risen to the surface, and it’s shining with seven colors of light.
